The watermelon n mango ice creams for desserts with tapioca were lush too! Good pricing with good food too from what we tried today!😋
Great food! I ordered their Seoul bagel sandwiches today, and they were both tasty and satisfying. I’ll definitely order again next time.

places.formatted_address: 176 Mawney Rd, Romford RM7 8BU, UK
places.name: Ottomans

reviews.text:
Food is absolutely delicious, always cooked to perfection. Had some huge orders and always get everything right!
Staff are lovely and super accommodating.
100% recommended!
James 159
Ordered on Just Eat. Food came within 20 minutes absolutely piping hot. Portion sizes were massive and quality of food was unreal. My new favourite place! Would 100% recommend.

Was passing through Romford for the day and thought I'd stop for a kebab. The sign in the window made a bold claim: 'Best Kebab in Romford'. I'm going to make an even bolder claim and say that this is by far, the best  kebab I've ever had! Also, thanks to the very polite man who served me. If I ever come past again, im 100% coming again!

Was looking for a healthy-ish dinner and found this place. To put it simply: the food was amazing! Arrived still warm, portions are big, delivery person was lovely, and most importantly the food was delicious! Everything was so tasty, will order again!
Great fast, Good service food. Staff was very helpful over the phone. Will defo order again . (Didn’t take pictures of my food, so I used the images from my order)

places.formatted_address: 1120 High Rd, Romford RM6 4AH, UK
places.name: Kasiba Lounge and Restaurant

reviews.text: Really Loved the atmosphere and vibe of the place. Staff were quite helpful and food/drinks were amazing. Lychee mojito is the must try. Shisha flavours were quality which is quite rare these days. Overall 9/10.

Had a fabulous experience. The food was delicious and fresh. Atmosphere is really nice. Staff is lovely as well. We had great time. We enjoy shisha and food and the dessert was amazing. I will definitely come again.

I visited this place with a friend after hearing some positive reviews, but unfortunately, it turned out to be a big disappointment. When we were finally ready to place our order, we were informed that the main dish we had chosen was unavailable. To our surprise, we were then told that no mains were available at all, and only starters could be ordered.

The staff member who took our order appeared unconcerned about the situation. It was 7 PM, and I was really hoping to enjoy a meal there, but ultimately, we had to leave and find another restaurant.

I won’t be coming back.

Amazing food and Shisha, definitely my go to lounge, each time iv gone  they have exceeded expectations, Live entertainment on weekends, Variety of foods drinks and selection of Shisha flavours all 10/10, Looking forward to going back, One of the best restaurant/ lounge iv been to :)
Check it out guys you won't be disappointed.
They have a new menu the food is amazing.
Thanks to Rehan exactly service from him and he mixes the best shisha :)

Thank you sooo much to Tania for her conversation, service and friendliness. My friend and I met up after a very long time and we chose to catch up at Millions lounge. The music was good, the interior designs was amazing and modern and bright. I'd only suggest more toilets. We had a fabulous time

places.formatted_address: 9 Endeavour Square, Stratford Cross, London E20 1JN, UK
places.name: Bread Street Kitchen, Bar & Rooftop - Stratford

reviews.text:
The quality of the food was more than I had expected as I was comparing to Gordon Ramsey in the Savoy. The quantity of food was certainly more than the Savoy. A good sized starter and main. We ordered sides of Fries mashed potato and salad which filled us up. A nice hot Brownie with ice cream finished the meal.
The service and staff were excellent. A very nice lunch which wasn't expensive. I can recommend and would use again.

Great service, friendly staff , nice atmosphere and good classic British food. Slightly pricey but it’s a well kept and fancy looking restaurant with an upmarket feel . Bonus that kids eat free. The kids Mac and cheese was very tasty . We also had the chicken & leek pie and the set menu chicken wings, Steak and fudge cake . All very good !

Restaurant looks amazing, the staff offer incredible customer service, and the food is a level of quality I'm sure Gordon would be proud of. The big portion of pork ribs is huge, and ver meaty, but the unexpected dishes that won everybody over were the meatball starters, and the Mac and cheese side dish.

Special thanks to the staff that served us. Cristina and Teo (? I might have his name wrong there, but I'm referring to the Albanian fellow.) were excellent, as was the manager there, and the lady at reception. If the restaurant offers any bonuses or commendations, I think they should be the ones to receive them. And as a disclaimer, they did NOT ask me to write a review or to mention them. I just thought they did an excellent job.

So, if you wanna dine fancy but not break the bank too much, this place has you covered.

Great atmosphere, staff are super polite and incredibly professional, unfortunately the food was a bit of a letdown, I ordered the fish and chips. It was very nice, very good portion, I would give it 9 out of 10. I have only deducted one point because the chips clearly weren’t made in the kitchen, they were just from a packet.
However, my daughter ordered the burger, to say it was dry was a understatement, it was really tasteless and not delicious at all. I would give it 5 out of 10 at best, this burger was not even as good as GBK. A big disappointment, Gordon you can do much better!!

2nd attempt was finally worthy!
Our first try was back in summer, but we were rudely rejected at the door.
This time, however, we were warmly welcomed and seated promptly.
A very good spot to check out in the Stratford area!

places.formatted_address: The Stratford, 20 International Wy, London E20 1FD, UK
places.name: Kokin Restaurant

reviews.text:
Dinner at 📍Kokin, Straford on the 7th floor of The Stratford hotel.

Wood fire inspired Japanese dishes with a focus on sustainable blue fin tuna. The smoke could be tasted in every course and bringing an extra dimension of savouriness where you wouldn’t expect them.

Most dishes were beautifully presented and well executed. We loved the starter platter which had a good variety of dishes. The sushi and sashimi tasted very fresh with the option to try wood fired smoked sushi rice. We paired this with bolder flavours so as not to overpower the more delicate.

The chicken dish was surprisingly the favourite with a deliciously rich egg yolk sauce. The tuna collar was the reason for my visit and did not disappoint. For me, the sauces were too strong and over seasoned the cod and tuna dishes.

The dining room was spacious and airy and service was great. We did have to wait a while for the sushi as it was made to order but the staff were very apologetic.

Overall a great experience and I hope to try their tuna carving events soon.

#japanesefood #woodfire #london #sushi #foodtok

Absolutely stunning food. All dishes so delicious. We have travelled around Japan, and this is the best Japanese food we’ve eaten in London. Better than Nobu. The staff were lovely - friendly and attentive. The price is high (for Stratford) but honestly the food is completely worth it. (Much better than Allegra, the previous restaurant here)

Favourites - the miso back cod and tuna collar mains were outstanding. All the sashimi and sushi were super fresh and beautifully presented. Smoked sushi rice was inspired. The egg custard and eel starter was incredible. And you can’t beat a glass of Nyetimber sparkling.

Thank you for a lovely evening. We’ll definitely be back.

Kokin was such a great experience. The food was super fresh, and the flavors blended together nicely without feeling heavy. The presentation was gorgeous, and the atmosphere felt classy but still quiet and comfortable, which made it easy to just relax and enjoy. The service really stood out too—friendly, attentive, and professional. I would definitely recommend the wagyu beef—it melted in my mouth! Honestly, everything from start to finish felt top notch, and I can’t wait to go back again.

We went there for lunch on Saturday, the Saturday lunch deal is quiet nice.
We had order the assorted starter, nigiri sets and extra sashimi chutoro and salmon.

Nigiri sets is nice, they pairing fish with different sauce like wasabi, ginger and yuzu.

Assorted starter has own character.
Home make tofu and the Saba sushi is my fav. Little bit more fav rather than soya sauce will be nice , at the end I find it is abit salty.

Sashimi has kept the good standard with reasonable price. although I have higher expectation on medium fatty tune which they are famous in. Salmon is better than most local sushi restaurant.

The atmosphere is pretty with nice view, there is a small outdoor garden that allow customer to visit.

It will be a nice place to hang out with friend in good weather.

Sashimi and oyster was a bit warm when served, I prefer raw seafood serve in cold.

The sushi here is actually very nice, very fresh and great taste, but portions is small so I guess is still worth the price. Customer service is actually good, very friendly and you can see they are trying their best, However I really think more training is needed as they keep bringing dishes to the wrong table and the food does take time to come out and I do hope this can be improved. Overall is a beautiful place, the chef has passion with his food and the team is nice.

places.formatted_address: 4 Arber Wy, Stratford Cross, London E20 1JS, UK
places.name: HERA

reviews.text: Stopped by HER for lunch and absolutely loved it. The place has such a beautiful, warm interior - stylish without feeling overdone, and really inviting. The food was fresh, flavourful, and well-balanced, and everything came out at just the right pace. You can tell they put thought into both the menu and the presentation.

The food was okay but had higher expectations.
I enjoyed the king prawn spaghetti but would have preferred having the shells off. Really enjoyed the bread basket, they were warm and flavourful especially with the dips.
I did not enjoy the lamb shoulder, I didn’t like the combination of tomatoy chickpeas, I don’t think it went well together (for my taste).
The mocktail Hestia was probably the worst i’ve ever had, there was no flavour and it was tiny considering it costs £10!
Overall it was a nice experience but I will not be rushing back here.

This is my second time here, I came with my partner and we were served by a lovely waiter named Mohammed. Prefect service, very polite and even gave us some recommendations in term of drinks and dessert. Great food, can’t wait to be back

The restaurant is lovely decorated. Most of the food was delicious except for the Greek Salad which was horrible. The veggies tasted like they were chopped hours before. I can't believe they do that on such a fancy restaurant. All the items were over priced. Some of the staff seemed bored. I don't think I will come back.

Entrance - I did find it quite hard to find the entrance as it’s quite hidden, but nothing google maps can’t fix. Once I found it, it was clear as day where the restaurant was as it was such a huge building.

Food - The food was very nice. I ordered the chicken skewers and a side of potato’s, both very nice. I don’t usually finish my meals but I finished everything on my plate which is always a good sign.

Drinks - I ordered a bottle of white wine with a mini bottle of lemonade, both very nice.

Decor - Very modern and aesthetically pleasing. I really liked the decor, it was beautiful, especially in the bathroom.

Atmosphere - Very nice, chilled, not busy at all for a Friday night which is what I prefer. It was relaxing.

Cleanliness - VERY clean, not a spec of dirt. Not even in the toilets. It looked and smelt clean. No issues with cleanliness.

Total cost - £78 for myself for both food and drinks.

Customer service - The customer service was amazing, from the moment I walked in and were greeted by a very beautiful lady with (I think) a French accent. She let us choose whichever table we wanted and was very warm with her mannerisms.

The waiters and waitresses were also very very nice. Very polite and extremely attentive. They had great recommendations with the food and whenever my wine glass was empty they topped it straight back up. I haven’t experienced customer service in a restaurant that good in years.

Overall - 10/10- The food was great, the staff were even better & the atmosphere was to die for.

I would definitely return.

Thank you HERA❤️

editorial_summary.overview: Comfortable restaurant specialising in Italian cuisine, including pasta, risotto & pizza.

places.formatted_address: 17 Endeavour Square, Stratford Cross, London E20 1JN, UK
places.name: FIGO Stratford

reviews.text:
Very nice ambiance. Service was good.

I have a Gluten intolerant, Janett have been very careful in checking on the items i wish to order and made suitable recommendations that works out to be a very yummy menu.

My husband ordered a pizza and requested for a Gluten free base so that I can have some too. The taste came out wonderfully.

Coffee is definitely Italian with a very dark roast finished.

Would recommend this place especially with their lunch deal menu. Portion is just nice.

This was my first time visiting, and everything we ordered was absolutely amazing. The flavors are so good. Simone was really thoughtful throughout the meal, he shared his personal favourites, explained the dishes in detail, and even asked for feedback to make sure we enjoyed everything. Will definitely come back!

Thank you to everyone at Figo - ​I had a fantastic lunch there yesterday and can't recommend it enough! From the moment I walked in, the staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating. I asked if they could modify one of their dishes because I'm not a fan of mushrooms, and they were more than happy to help.

​The service was top-notch, and the food was absolutely delicious - it's clear that the kitchen takes great pride in what they do! I'm already looking forward to my next visit to try more of their great-looking menu!
Good food, but mixed feelings about staff. Waiters confused, managed to mess up a simple order. One of the chefs constantly staring (we sat by the kitchen counter), slightly uncomfortable experience.

In another world I might have worked in the building above this restaurant. Weird how things go.

Anyhow, staying in Stratford for a couple of nights (as one does) and looking for a place to eat, what better than an Italian I thought – the aesthetic of the place is good, there is soft lighting, meat hangs invitingly  in a cupboard and there is a large false tree, squarely planted in the centre of the restaurant, a challenge to convention.

Seated without a reservation on a Monday night, the vibe was relatively relaxed – tables are quite close together though, so it might be quite noisy when it is full. I understand that this is part of a small chain, with a couple of other restaurants in the area – I felt it reminded me of a place I visited in Portugal, although I’m not sure if that was because they both had a tree inside, or because Figo was a famous Portuguese footballer and that was confusing me…

Service was efficient and menus and drinks were provided soon after seating – just a Diet Coke for me as I continue to respect my liver ahead of the festive period. Otherwise, there was Peroni, the beer to have a in a place like this.

For a starter, I chose the arancini – these were unctuous and rich – possibly too rich, with their cheesy centres and sitting in a bed of thick creamy sauce. So very good. If I hadn’t had these, there was calamari and garlic bread with mozzarella – although I’d only have the latter if I wasn’t having a pizza for my main as it is basically another pizza… 😃

For a main, a pizza – I shouldn’t really order pizzas as I can never finish them, but I do like them so very much. This one was salsicca, with sausage and mushroom – I added an egg to it, as that was an option and you should always take up the option to add an egg to your pizza when it is offered. Rare these days. The pizza was glorious, with a thin base and generous helping of thick sausage (who doesn’t love a generous portion of meat?)  – the egg, which was served with a perfectly runny yolk, sat atop the centre f the pizza like a preening beast surveying it’s territory, ready to spread forth its joy upon the land. As you can no doubt tell, I liked this pizza – if you’re eating here, I would definitely recommend the pizza and I wholeheartedly endorse the addition of an egg.

Dessert was offered, but as I hadn’t finished my pizza, I demurred – there was tiramisu though, which is ‘the’ pudding. Hard to say no to tiramisu.

Overall a good experience and I would come here again. Price was not bad, given the location and quality of the restaurant and the food. Two paws up.

places.formatted_address: 21-24 Victory Parade, East Village, London E20 1FS, UK
places.name: Bamboo-Mat Stratford

reviews.text: Had lunch at Bamboo-Mat Stratford and it was a great experience! The ambiance is stylish and modern, and the food was fresh and full of flavor. The service was also friendly and quick. Highly recommended.

Best tasting menu I’ve ever had! For £62 per person you get extremely large plates of delicious dishes that reflects Japanese and Peruvian cuisine. Not only was the food astonishing, the service was fantastic as well.
Highly recommend this place over chotto matte

Had seen alot of 5/5 reviews so I thought I would come and try out Bamboo Mat.

To be honest it was empty, so I couldn't really judge the atmosphere.

Service was ok, but nothing special.

Food was good, nice sushi, menu had a good variety to choose from.
One of the stand out dishes was the octopus.

Overall I think a 3/5 is a true reflection compared to all the Japanese restaurants I have visited.
We were pleasingly surprised by the quality of the food! They serve delicious Japanese Peruvian  dishes! Definitely recommend it if you are in Stratford

I recently visited this venue with two friends of mine. Both of my friends brought their kids, two babies and one toddler. The staff made us feel very welcomed and were patient with us. The food was amazing, we ordered the tastings menus and all the dishes had so much flavour. The grilled octopus was cooked to perfection. It’s hard to pick the fav dishes because all of them were super lovely and the presentation was fantastic. Will be returning.

places.formatted_address: 40 Celebration Ave, East Village, London E20 1DB, UK
places.name: Union Social

reviews.text:
Me and sister came here for a quick lunch after seeing a relative off at Stansted Airport.

We were served by Sadat. Who was very welcoming and friendly. Thank you.

The food was very nice and delicious I have been here before but was nice to be here again. Plus portion sides were great for a light lunch.

We liked the venue but did move tables as it was slightly darker in some parts of the seating area.

This is my second time at this nice and cosy place!
Service very good, stuff really friendly. We stayed inside but they have a lovely terrace as well.
probably one of the best homemade flatbread in London! other dishes were also alright, but when I was there on weekday lunchtime not many choices. anyways enjoyed very calm moments with my friend.
Very nice place for brunch near Stratford International. It's just a shame they don't serve pancakes or some other brunch food, but the Eggs Benedict and pasta were very good.
Possibly the best experience we've had. Staff and service were impeccable! Thank you Safwan, Gloria, and Davide for looking after us!!!

places.formatted_address: 105 - 106 Westfield Shopping Centre The Street, London E20 1EN, UK
places.name: Lokma Westfield

reviews.text: I had my birthday dinner here yesterday and was amazed with the service. The food was amazing - tasted lovely and the portions were really big for the price. Aida was so helpful and attentive and made sure everyone was satisfied at the dinner. She really made me feel more at ease. Another waiter played a game with us at the beginning which was a nice way to get us having fun.

Went here for a catch up with a friend and the atmosphere was really nice. The shisha was pretty standard, even though we went for a premium flavour—and at £45 it felt quite pricey for what it was.

We also ordered 3 starters, 2 drinks (hot chocolate + latte) and a pitcher jug, and the bill came to over £100, which felt super expensive considering we didn’t get that much. On top of that, they only accept cash, which was a bit annoying. Service was okay, nothing special, but overall the vibe of the place was nice 😊

Definitely my favourite Turkish in London. Would highly recommend.

I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve been here over the years, with groups of 2 to 10+, and it has always been consistently good. Went here the other day on a lovely, warm, sunny day and sat in the outdoor area - felt like I was enjoying an al-fresco dining experience abroad. Lovely relaxed atmosphere.

Massive portions and the food is full of flavour and the meat/ chicken was tender and moist and always cooked to perfection and the chilli sauce is amazing. The kunefa is the show stopper though, and probably better than those I’ve had in Istanbul - there’s not many Turkish restaurants that sell it so I was so glad to find out that they do a few years ago - is the main reason I come here tbh - it’s cooked fresh and not heated up out of a box, it’s just the perfect dessert to end the meal.

Staff are friendly and polite and the service is excellent. Reasonably priced for what you’re getting compared to other places in a prime location.

The staff were super friendly and welcoming. There’s plenty of seating both inside and outside, which is perfect depending on the weather. Some evenings they have happy hour deals, and there’s even a belly dancer and magician which makes it a really fun vibe. Loads of meat options on the menu and a few fish dishes too, so there’s something for everyone. Definitely recommend if you're looking for good food, good vibes, and a relaxed night out! (If you get the sea bass it contains bones)

I ordered the moussaka and it was really good, really big portions! I have allergies and the manager ensured everything was checked thoroughly. Would highly recommend and come again. Efsa was such a pleasure. Giving 4 stars only because i was disappointed to see soft drinks on the menu that are on the boycott list. Please change this and I will give a 5 star!

places.formatted_address: 10a, Chestnut Plaza, Westfield, London E20 1GL, UK
places.name: Elondi Restaurant, Bar and Terrace

reviews.text: We came for lunch with my husband and baby. The bar and terrace areas are very  nice decoration wise. The vibe is really chill and invite to sit down. The terrace was too cold for us and decided to go in the restaurant area which was a bit empty but we were very reassured to see that the food was very good. We had nachos, chicken curry and cesar salad. All were very tasty. The service was a bit slow but helpful. There was also enough room for our pram / baby which was great.

It's a lovely hidden gem located in the Hyatt Regency. I ordered the pan seared salmon, mash and sauce. The salmon was perfectly cooked,  moist, well seasoned with flawless mash. Great service with friendly and attentive staff. Great ambience with a range of tables inside and outside on the terrace. An ideal place to relax and unwind in the evening. Highly recommended.
It's quite nice restaurant inside hotel. We visited just passed lunch time for quick relaxing meals. It was nice not crowded. Good atmosphere and the service was good. Will go back again.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Hyatt hotel, and I can’t recommend it enough! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel right at home with their warm welcome and attentive service. The room was spotless, well-designed, and offered a beautiful view, making it the perfect place to relax.

delicious and amazing restaurant
Every interaction with the team showed their genuine commitment to guest satisfaction, and they went above and beyond to accommodate our requests.

Thank you to everyone and also Alex the manager at the restaurant when he was very polite and friendly and make very special an unforgettable experience.looking forward to returning on our next trip.”

We stopped there just for a drink but ended up staying much longer than we expected - and we’re so glad we did! I had visited this place years ago under different ownership, but now it’s so much better - especially because of the amazing service.
The staff were absolutely fantastic: friendly, professional and welcoming. Special mention to the Lithuanian lady, who really stood out. She made us feel right at home and gave us every reason to come back again. She’s definitely our favourite! Highly recommend this place - we’ll definitely be back. 😊

places.formatted_address: The Gantry, 40 Celebration Ave, East Village, London E20 1DB, UK
places.name: STK Steakhouse – Stratford

reviews.text:
The food was absolutely delicious and we were pleasantly surprised by the portion sizes (especially the starters). None of us had any steak, however, the quality of the food we consumed could only indicate that the steaks would be divine.

Our server Demitri was absolutely wonderful! Very attentive and friendly. A very personable young man. He helped to make my dad's birthday celebrations very special. I'd visit again and I'd highly recommend a visit.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ Three-Star Experience with Five-Star Service

Visited this beautifully located venue with panoramic views of the now fully developed surrounding area. The ambiance was lively and enjoyable, thanks to excellent music throughout the evening and an outstanding team of staff.

Service: From the outset, the service was impeccable. Our server, Armari, if I caught his name correctly, was a true professional. He guided us through the menu with warmth and clarity, making us feel genuinely welcome.

Food:
For the main course, I opted for the Surf & Turf: a 200g filet paired with grilled king prawns. While the flavors were good, the dish didn’t quite justify its £53 price tag. The prawns were notably small and lacked their shell and tail, which detracted from both presentation and value. Additionally, fries were charged at £10 extra, a surprising choice for what should be a standard side.

Dessert:
I finished with the chocolate fudge cake served with vanilla ice cream and cocoa crumble. It was pleasant, but slightly underwhelming, the cake was firm and lacked the warm, melting texture that would have elevated it.

Drinks:
Two glasses of Moët Brut added a touch of luxury to the evening, perfectly chilled and consistently excellent.

Final Thoughts:
While the service and setting were top-tier, the pricing and portion sizes left something to be desired. A lovely evening overall, but not quite the value expected at this price point.

Recently i celebrated my birthday here,  as the location was central to shopping .
Kerry our server was attentive which was the right mix. She didn't hoover
The food was good, dessert was a dream, that mac and cheese,  I have no words.
The vibe was good with the Dj providing the upbeat tempo.

Love it need to check out the Sunday brunch vibe
Saule was an amazing server! She gave great suggestions and was super helpful. The vibes with the music were excellent and the food was soooooo tasty. Will be coming back and would recommend.

The views and customer service at STK Stratford is fantastic.
The waiting staff were polite, kind and knowledgeable. They suggested alternatives when dishes were not suitable for dietary requirements.

The food tasted good, however the portion of the dishes do not justify the costs e.g. two pieces of lamb chops for £38.00.
Most of the dishes can be modified so that those seeking a halal/ non alcoholic dish can also enjoy meals, however they do not provide alternative jus and you will need to purchase additional sauce. This is the case for almost all their dishes.

I can't see this restaurant sustaining itself in Stratford with their current prices.

editorial_summary.overview: Refined, industrial spot for carefully sourced Northern Italian cuisine, plus cocktails & wine.

places.formatted_address: 16-19 Victory Parade, East Village, London E20 1FS, UK
places.name: Darkhorse Restaurant Bar

reviews.text:
We had our wedding celebration at Dark Horse, and it truly exceeded all expectations. This isn’t just another restaurant in London – it feels like home. From the moment we started planning, the team treated us like old friends, offering a truly personal and individual approach that made everything feel so special.

The venue itself is stunning – stylish interior, big windows, and so much natural light. It’s a bright, welcoming space that felt both elegant and relaxed. The outdoor terrace was a huge bonus – our guests loved having a spot to step outside, chill between dancing, and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s tucked away from busy roads, which made it feel really private and intimate – perfect for a special occasion.

We chose the shared menu, and it was absolutely perfect. There was more than enough food, and every dish was delicious – our guests couldn’t stop raving about it and many said they’d come back just for dinner!

A huge thank you to Matt, who managed the evening seamlessly – thanks to him, we were able to relax and just enjoy our party. Nicole and the rest of the staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and polite – it felt like they were genuinely happy to celebrate with us. And a special thanks to Ian for his excellent communication and flexibility throughout the planning process.

We couldn’t recommend Dark Horse more. It’s now our family spot – whether for special occasions, a great dinner, or a cozy Sunday roast, we’ll definitely be back.

An interesting layout. The staff team were very attentive throughout, making sure our group dietary needs were well taken care of. The wine selection was impressive, offering something for every taste. The food was excellent. The ambiance is modern and refreshing
Lovely dinner on a Friday evening. The food was all good, but three course was a bit much. We got the set menu for £29 (3 courses), but sides were extra. Would happily come back again.
The food there was delicious, and the service was very friendly as well. My family enjoyed very much so.

Great food cocktails and service. A nice selection of wines. The black pig pork chop is great and the menu changes relatively regularly always something nice to choose. It's our most visited local restaurant.

places.formatted_address: 70-73 The Mall (unit 10, London E15 1XQ, UK
places.name: Mezban stratford

reviews.text: Excellent halal food good mix of south Asian and Arabic dishes, we visited twice in one week. We ordered a partha dish which came layered in a banana leaves topped with meat fry chicken fry and chicken curry. We also tried the dosa and biryani all very flavourful and very affordable.
Prime location, but flavor falls short 🍛👎 Despite being in a great spot, the food didn't quite live up to expectations. Prices felt steep for the quality.
Had meals, pazhampori beef, and ended with chai everything tasted just like proper South Indian home-cooked food. Friendly staff cozy atmosphere, and proper South Indian flavors
To be frank, I entered with the least expectation, but the food was very tasty and amazing! 😋 Good service and a welcoming atmosphere.  #Restaurant #Food #Dinner #Surprise #GoodTimes

Tucked away in the “market” portion of Stratford shopping center, this place has authentic South Indian food that makes for the perfect lunch. No frills and a bit hot, if you tend to run warm, the food is delicious and varied. I’ve gotten the Pernnal Choru and the masala dosa and both were filling and delicious

places.formatted_address: 158 Westfield Ave, London E20 1EN, UK
places.name: Big Easy Bar.B.Q & Crabshack - Westfield, Stratford

reviews.text:
Disappointing!

I have been to the Canary Wharf branch when I worked in the area and had fond memories of good food & service.  Stratford falls short of that benchmark.

Good welcome om
shown to a table very near a stage for love music later in the evening.  This area looked fine but as the evening progressed I felt they were short of a couple of servers. Long wait for orders to be taken, yes there was a couple of allergies (black pepper and soya) so it might have needed a manager.

We shared chicken  wings - great looking good for the rest. Potato skins  were OK but not special. Mains shrimp basket over cooked chewy and rubbery . I had a steak medium rare at first glance it looked well done with significant charring, inside it was fairly rare but combined it was slightly odd.  Chips with both and most of the pots were left, not crispy or particularly tasty. The third member of party sat those course out expecting to order desert but in the end suggested we cut short the evening.

£120 (including drinks but only one alcoholic drink) spent - one dish enjoyed the rest sub par.

We attended here after an event. Were able to get straight in without a booking on a Saturday which was great. Staff very helpful and friendly! The food was really good, the only thing that let it down for me was the rib tips were dry and the brioche bun needs freshly toasting or placing under a dome for a while to soften the bread. Fries we amazing!
We both had the cappucino milkshake which was so so good!
BBQ sauces on the table would be a massive plus!

All in all a good BBQ meal for slightly high price.

I had a meal at Big Easy in Stratford City and it was definitely a mixed experience. Portion sizes were generous, which was great. I ordered the Texas-style beef brisket—easily one of the tastiest things I’ve ever eaten—but unfortunately, it was served quite cold. I would have loved it to be much warmer. The coleslaw was too runny and heavy on the mayonnaise, lacking flavour. The chunky chips tasted a bit too processed for my liking. On a positive note, the beans were delicious and packed with flavour. My husband’s burger was okay, but nothing memorable. That said, the shrimps and brisket were absolutely spot on—we’ll definitely come back just for those! Service was a bit slow, but overall, we had a decent experience.
The food was very good!! I recommend the ribs and the sirloin steak. It tastes so good!! The staff is very friendly and thank you so much Anila for serving us🙏 Came back multiple times.
The lunch set is a really good deal — very yummy! The staff are friendly and welcoming, and I’ll definitely come again. Highly recommend!

places.formatted_address: 49, Stratosphere Tower, Great Eastern Rd, London E15 1DL, UK
places.name: ZUZU BISTRO BAR

reviews.text: I had an awful experience from a very unprofessional and misogynistic man today. I asked for a recommendation of a sweet white wine, I got given a dessert wine, not what I asked for and in my opinion, disgusting. So I sent it back and asked for a white wine instead, the woman serving us was so lovely and this review is not a reflection of her at all she did her job and I honestly believe it was a miscommunication issue between us. This man pictured below came back and put the drink I sent back in front of me, “I believe this is yours?” He got very nasty as soon as he approached us, I told him politely I didn’t like it and it wasn’t what I requested. Eventually he left, when we paid at the end I asked for his name, he leant over the till and with a smug smile said “why? So you can complain about me” I explained my complaint to him and how it made my whole party feel really uncomfortable the way he acted and spoke to me and we left after that drink instead of continuing our night and ordering food and more drinks. He told me (as he was standing next to our waitress) she is a woman, she is wrong and she has done bad, come to a man next time”. This escalated my frustration and I told him that she was very lovely and my complain is about him and not the waitress that served us. She looked upset by this comment and it hurt to see. I made it clear to him how ugly his comment was and he told me “I hate customers like you who put on a show” bare in mind I didn’t raise my voice once. I left the restaurant really upset and annoyed. I hope this girl doesn’t go through this or worse regularly.

We went on Sunday night with my husband. We were pleasantly surprised about their Sunday deal of £20 of one hot or cold starter, choice of 12 oz ribeye or sirloin steak and a glass of wine. The steak perfectly cooked the way I wanted it. It’s juicy and tender. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The ambience is perfect for a lovely dinner to unwind ready to start a new week. We will definitely come back when we return to London.

Travelled from Manchester. Everything about Zuzu’s was mind blowing! We were served complimentary olives and fresh hot bread whilst waiting for our meal. The lamb shank was the best I have had in a long time, if not ever! It simply melts off the bone and dissolves in your mouth. Not to mention the fantastic friendly staff. I will definitely be back soon on my future visits to this side of London.

We came here today and tried their Sunday deal, which includes a main course, an appetizer, and a glass of red wine for just £20 — such great value! I had the steak as my main and the 6-1 as my appetizer. The portions were generous, and everything tasted amazing. Our waiter, Sumi, was super friendly and gave us excellent service throughout. Highly recommend this place — definitely worth a visit!
Turkish chef cooks delicious foods I highly recommend lamb with yogurt thanks for service as well. And also steak was good. Thank you for hospitability of Göksel..

editorial_summary.overview: Low-lit Thai chain restaurant with a modern dark wood interior and square communal tables.

places.formatted_address: Westfield Ave, London E20 1GL, UK
places.name: Busaba Westfield Stratford

reviews.text: Visited Busaba for the first time - we are visiting UK from Australia & thoroughly enjoyed our Thai meal. Christy was a delight & very caring as to our needs. If I had a criticism it was the satay chicken was not hot but the flavour & tenderness was exceptional. Soup was sensational as was duck dish. Enjoyed a few dishes & considering we came across the restaurant by chance we were extremely happy with the end result. Highly recommend. It’s shared tables but personally we found the concept fun. And Kevvy & Tilly ( yes little koala friends -  @kevvytillyontour ) loved the mango sorbet & Coconut icecream!!! Will definitely go back when next in UK. Thank you Christy. Best wishes

I had the most wonderful experience at Busaba in Westfield Stratford - truly a 5-star restaurant with a 5-star service!. The food was absolutely delicious, vibrant, and of the highest quality, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting with beautiful mellow lighting and elegant ceiling fans that added to the ambience.
As a wheelchair user, dining out can sometimes be difficult and I often feel like an inconvenience, but not here. I was looked after by the Manager Andrew, who provided outstanding service from start to finish. He was polite, helpful, and attentive, and he made me feel more than welcome. It's a joy and pleasure (though not often these days) to get service with a smile from people who clearly enjoy and love the job they do and take pride in doing the best job they can. Andrew catered to all my needs, including ensuring easy access to the accessible restroom, which made a world of difference to my experience.
Compliments also to the chef, who did an amazing job - every dish was so tasty and full of flavour, and beautifully presented. So whether you're stopping for a light lunch or celebrating a special occasion, this is an amazing place to come.
Busaba has quickly become one of my favourite places to visit, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. Top quality food, outstanding service, and a truly welcoming atmosphere - everything you could ask for in a restaurant.

Delicious food and great ambience at Busaba Stratford

I ate at the Busaba in Stratford and really enjoyed it. The food was tasty and well-cooked — the lamb especially was so tender it just fell off the bone. The ambience was relaxed yet stylish, making it a lovely place to sit and enjoy a meal. Service was good too. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in Westfield Stratford and fancy some Thai food.

My last birthday treat from my gorgeous girl. We ate early, 16:30,  but there were already a few diners and it filled up quickly. We started with the calamari, done in a way I’ve never tried, I highly recommend if you love calamari and are looking for a fresh idea (I’m sure I am late to the party).  We had Pad Thai prawn, the duck and green curry for mains, all delicious, the coconut rice and roti were both perfect compliments. We ordered and ate a lot but we didn’t feel overfull. All in all, we had a lovely meal and would recommend you book a table if you love Thai cuisine.

Visited Stratford and stopped in for lunch. The dining experience was a little different, with lots of large communal tables, so you might end up sharing a table with someone you don’t know. That said, I was pleasantly surprised by the food! Great flavours and quality, definitely worth a visit if you're in the area.

editorial_summary.overview: Bright, hip spot with gourmet comfort food for breakfast, lunch & dinner, plus latte art & desserts.

places.formatted_address: 369 High St, Greater, London E15 4QZ, UK
places.name: XIX Nineteen

reviews.text: The food is so delicious here!!! We ordered Nineteen for our wedding catering, and it was such a great experience!!! The food was extremely tasty, the service was nice, and the whole team was super flexible and friendly, which we appreciate a lot! I also want to thank a lot to manager Volodymyr for handling everything, we appreciate it a lot! We had an amazing experience, and very grateful to the whole team Nineteen for making it happen ❤️

I was not expecting such good taste from Ukrainian food, definitely something to try.

The place is big and can hold a big party of like 12 to 15 persons. They not only have Ukrainian food but a wide variety of sushi, salads, typical occidental dishes like hamburgers, pizza, wings, etc.

Their drink of both alcoholic and non-alcoholic is great, along with their desserts, you definitely need to try the dumplings and pancakes.

Additionally, consider a lot of the stuff is done at the moment so some dishes may take time to be served.

The waiters are very nice and they are very open to explain to you more about a certain dish or give recommendations.

Probably the best Ukrainian restaurant in London so far. Borsch will bring you back home, to your grandmothers kitchen when you were a child, chicken kyiv and mash will remind you home, and many more! The best place to experience and try Ukrainian dishes. Chef top notch! Service one love🫶🏻

Portions were huge!
The fried potato meat pancakes - WOW. Loved it!!
The chebureki was crispy and also went really well with the sour cream.
Wasn’t a huge fan of the pelmeni - felt the skin was a little too thick for me.

This restaurant is a real gem! From the moment we walked in, we felt welcome and at home. The interior is stylish yet comfortable, creating the perfect atmosphere for both casual dining and special occasions. Every dish we had was full of flavor and clearly made with fresh ingredients. The service was excellent - polite, fast and very professional. Our waiter was the best and a special thanks to the receptionist for the compliment and the great live music. This is definitely a place worth visiting again. Highly recommended!

places.formatted_address: Queen Elizabeth, Olympic Park, 20 International Wy, London E20 1GQ, UK
places.name: Kitchen E20

reviews.text:
Having had good experiences at E20 previously, we thought it was time for another visit.

This is such an underrated restaurant! It is really competitively priced. A la carte offers good value, and the set menus are an absolute steal. My chaps suggested Five Guys after bowling, but I persuaded them to eat properly!

We each had a main:
Octopus 🐙
Lamb and asparagus
Prawn Linguine

A lovely bottle of Viognier converted someone who "doesn't like floral whites".
.
We ate late, around 9.45. Front of house staff were the perfect blend of polish and warmth. I was really impressed by the service.

Food was great. Presentation was mostly gorgeous and the dishes were well thought-out and balanced. Chef got his colour combinations just right. Perhaps adding a little more depth to the dishes would be welcome. In particular the lamb would be improved by a busier plate. A shame, as the meat was delicious but looked a little lost on the plate.

Highly recommend tucking into East London doing fairly fine dine, and doing it very well. Kudos to the Chef, he is extremely talented. Keep up the good work.

We have come here quite a few times for lunch and supper. They have a really great chicken and leek pie on their winter menu that you should really try we really enjoy and the salads they do in the summer. The chef, Adam, does a very good job. Thank you also to Ashley, Lina, Pavel, Cristina and it is great to have Laura and Lewis look after us.

Not great overall. The place looks amazing, very fancy. We sat outside which was a lovely atmosphere with the heaters, the seating was comfortable as well. But then we had to wait over an hour for our food, there was a mistake with our order and we would’ve never received it if we didn’t say anything. The pizzas were standard nothing special at all but the triple cooked chips were amazing. To be fair they gave us a full refund including our drinks which was appreciated after our wait.

The veggie breakfast was nice and the fruit selection and multiple juices was what I needed. But for 20 quid, the price is abit steep. I think if portions were larger and buffet had more selection it would be great.
The staff were amazing though and I really enjoyed the atmosphere.

Great ambience and place to go for happy hour drinks (til 7pm) and oysters on a Wednesday (£1.50). Sadly the pizza oven was broken, so we couldn’t have pizza.
Special thanks to Ingrid the manager who went out of her way to make us feel welcome and Lewis the waiter.

editorial_summary.overview: Mexican restaurant with a lively soundtrack for small plates of market-style food & cocktails.

places.formatted_address: 6, Chestnut Plaza, Westfield stratford city, London E20 1GL, UK
places.name: Wahaca Stratford

reviews.text:
I’d heard of this chain previously but had allowed myself to be put off by a general distaste for the person who recommended it. Foolish of me. I learn. He was someone who never tipped though, so you can understand the sentiment.

Anyhow, staying in Stratford for a couple of nights and this place was very near my hotel (Hyatt) – I love Mexican food and, from what I could see through the window, it looked very tasty. I thought therefore I’d give it a go.

The interior of the restaurant has a faux industrial/rustic vibe going on, with exposed rebar (I like a bit of exposed rebar) and mismatched seating, some of it sunken in the manner of the 1970s. The restaurant is brightly lit, which is a good thing as there were several steps. The kitchen is semi-open and raised, so you can see the food upon the pass. Nice to see. The only negative for me was a big painting of sweetcorn on the wall – I have a visceral dislike of sweetcorn. This is a personal thing though and shouldn’t put you off visiting. For some reason the sweetcorn is multicoloured and is being visited by a large honeybee, I didn’t understand that.

Service was quick and efficient, and the waiter tried hard to interest us in the special – normally I would have jumped at this as the special was Birria (I love Birria), but it was a sort of sandwich thing and I wasn’t in the mood for bread. I find bread is a mood these days, whereas once upon time I couldn’t get enough of it. Interesting how we change as we age. I ordered a Diet Coke for my drink, as I continue to offer respect to my liver ahead of the festive period.

The menu is interesting, it isn’t divided up in a traditional way – starters, mains etc. You have some small things as like pre-dinner snacks, then some small plates, then some large plates, some sides and some random things that don’t fit anywhere. You can design your meal. I like this, but I know some it would not sit well with. Anyhow, given that choice I thought I’d have a double helping of tacos, because tacos are life. Beef Gringa and buttermilk chicken – these were very different, the beef was saucy and rich, the chicken was fried and crisp, both adorned with loved accoutrement. Impressive tacos, I really enjoyed these and would certainly order them again. Whilst dining, I saw a burrito being eaten at the next table – it was huge – I’m glad I didn’t order that.

I thought I’d break tradition and have a pudding here – this was mainly because they have combined two of my favourites into a single dish with a marriage of tiramisu and a tres leches cake, to create a tres leches tiramisu. Gosh this was rich, delicious, creamy and rich. Beautiful, sweet pudding, I could have had this again and again. Definitely have this if you visit.

Overall, a successful visit and the price was more than reasonable for such tasty food – I would recommend a visit here. Two paws up. Don’t let yourself be put off trying things, give it a go.

Dining in Stratford is a strange experience – I prefer these restaurants that are ‘outside’ of the shopping centre rather than clustered together around it’s internal food market area. Better opportunities for people-watching.

We walked in without a booking and they found us a lovely table away from children (school holidays). The staff are all incredibly friendly and efficient. They had some great deals. We had the feasting menu (pictured), which was probably a little too much for two averaged sized people, it didn’t leave room for a pudding.

The cocktails and mocktails are equally delicious. You don’t miss the alcohol in their cocktails.

Bathrooms have separate male, female and disabled loos, although everyone shares the sinks, ideal if you just want to wash your hands before you eat.

I think Wahaca has gradually become much more of a mainstream chain restaurant and this one is no exception.

I ate here for lunch today in a party of two and the total cost was £65 (no alcohol).

Staff were friendly and food served pretty quickly.

Everything was good apart from the cauliflower bites (greasy / old oil taste). Pork pibil and vegetarian nachos particularly good.

Hibiscus drink and mocktail both really nice.

Visited the place after a long day of walking, me and my friend we were famishing.
After a revamp of their menu the food was still good none the less our server Agnes K. treat us with an exceptional customer service.
Especially in our day where it seems to be dissaperi g slowly. She was, nice, helpful, suggested us options and very calm.
Thank you Agnes!

We had a pleasant lunch here on a Saturday. We were served by Paolo who was very friendly and attentive. We ordered the beef and grilled chicken tacos, as well as the prawn small plate. The food was good, although the prawns were a bit small. Dog friendly in the outdoor area. Would come back.

places.formatted_address: 42-45 Victory Parade, East Village, London E20 1FS, UK
places.name: Santi

reviews.text: The food was enjoyable overall, though my Bufalina pizza was overwhelmed by an excess of sauce, which masked some of the flavour. No water was offered or provided at the table, which was a surprising oversight. Interestingly, while service during the meal was slow, the bill arrived with notable speed once we had finished.

Fresh off the plane in London after two weeks in Italy, I came here with high expectations and was pleasantly surprised to have them met. Pizza was thin crust and delicious. Staff were friendly and sitting outside was lovely on a balmy summer evening.

We went for an early dinner, unfortunately the seafood wasn't very fresh initially. Surprisingly, they changed it to a salmon dish for me. The salmon was delicious and fresh in addition to being free of charge. What a lovely restaurant. GRAZIE

Unexpected find this. Italian restaurant in the newish residential square beyond Stratford International. Had a European vibe. Reminded me of Düsseldorf, the bit behind the Holiday Inn. A good choice.

Seated without reservation on a Wednesday night, the restaurant was popular without being too busy. Mixed crowd - families, couples and a big work party worshipping their colleague.

The beer was Menabrea. Increasingly popular these days. We’re a long way from Glasgow now.

Really good choices on the menu - opted for arancini to start (beautiful and fresh), with a Versuvio pizza as main. The latter topped with salami and a gorgeously runny egg. Yes. The yolk burst and flowed across the pizza  and my heart swelled. So rare. Nice thin base with fluffy crust; the pizzaolo knows their craft.

For pudding there was, of course, tiramisu. Of course. A standard tiramisu but decent. I shall sing no songs of it though.

Overall a good choice; service was excellent and quick and the food was fresh and tasty. A visit is recommended if you like these things. If you do not, then Westfield awaits 🙌🏻

The service was top tier. Though to be fair when we visited it was near empty. The atmosphere is incredible, the music wasnt too loud and was very lovely. Though sadly I did not enjoy the food. The bread was a bit stale and soggy and the food was quite cold.

editorial_summary.overview: Family-friendly hangout serving a grill-based menu plus pasta in simple, modern surroundings.

places.formatted_address: 38 Romford Rd, London E15 4BZ, UK
places.name: The Grill Stratford

reviews.text:
Great Family-Friendly Halal Spot!
We visited The Stratford Grill for dinner and had such a wonderful experience. The food was excellent – the steaks were juicy and full of flavour, and the desserts were a real treat. What really stood out was how family-friendly the place is. It felt welcoming and comfortable, making it easy to enjoy the evening with everyone. We also really appreciated that the menu is halal, which gave us peace of mind and let us enjoy everything without worry. The service was attentive, the atmosphere was relaxed, and overall it was a perfect choice for both families and special occasions. Thanks to Rahul for serving us perfectly.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
@mr.shake_rover

Had an amazing experience at the grill in Stratford very good customer service very nice food I enjoyed everything but especially loved them creamy mash the most and I got a mixed grill cooked well well seasoned and amazing service from Rahul very good always checking in seeing if we wanted anything more, how are we enjoying the food? He was really nice so 10 out of 10 for Rahul Customer service👍🏾

Food was very good but can be better in places, kartik and mani were friendly and attentive. They gave a free sauce on the house and were attentive and checked all was ok. The recommended burger was tasty and tender and curly fries were nice when hot and fresh. The mini grill was OK but chicken wings a little smelly and one of the lamb chops had a bit of uncooked fat in the crevice, the other one was nice and sausage, chicken strips and rice were tasty. I left satisfied as portion sizes were decent value for money, a little pricey considering no sides offered with mains but expected for a nice night out in a restaurant. Will consider returning again as there's enough good food but will avoid the chicken wings.

I recently had a fantastic meal at The Grill Stratford and wanted to share my experience. From start to finish, the food was absolutely top-notch, and it's a spot I'd highly recommend.
For starters, I got the buffalo wings and black tiger prawns. The wings had a great kick and were perfectly cooked, while the prawns were juicy and full of flavour. Both dishes were a great way to kick off the meal.
But the real star of the show was the ribeye steak. It was incredibly tender, cooked to perfection, and melted in my mouth with every bite. It was easily one of the best steaks I’ve had in a long time.
While my main focus was on the steak, I also had a taste of the burger, and it didn’t disappoint. It was hearty, well-seasoned, and a great choice if you're not in the mood for a steak.
Overall, the quality of the food at The Grill Stratford is superb. If you're looking for a place with excellent steaks and a solid menu all around, this is definitely the place to go.

Very amazing experience from the start, no reservation made and got a table immediately even though it was a Saturday. Had QR code on the table to check the menu and order food on, very convenient.

Food and drinks came just after 20 minutes and after seeing the quality of the food I was very surprised it only took 20 minutes. The chicken and steak were very tender (chicken fell off the bone as soon as I even tried to put it on my place) , we ordered the ‘mega feast’ and it was much larger than expected (we had to end up taking takeaway).

Also I can’t stress enough how perfectly seasoned everything was, even their special sauces they bring with the food is beyond perfect. Honestly this alone is the main reason I WILL be returning!

Drinks were also very nice, especially the bubblegum mocktail.

Staff were very nice and friendly, checking in on us if we needed anything but not to the point where it was smothering. Manager was also very friendly and welcoming!

The prices were very affordable (£7-20 each) with large portions. And if you’re a picky eater like me this place is definitely for you! (They also have the option to put special requests for each food item when ordering online, so very easy to ask to remove certain things!)

places.formatted_address: 36-39 Victory Parade, East Village, London E20 1FS, UK
places.name: THE FAT CRAB STRATFORD

reviews.text: The host was amazing, she super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. It was a quiet day, which was nice and relaxing. I’m a big seafood fan, so I ordered the seafood boil, definitely recommend! The Cajun sauce was especially good, full of flavour. I also tried the baby rice crab based on some reviews, but honestly, they were just mid 😵‍💫 wouldn’t recommend those. Overall, though, I really enjoyed everything else!

The food here is fresh and really tasty. Would definitely try all the sauces and will be going back to try more on the menu.
Staff are happy and pleasant and do not over attend and the music is vibrant and at a perfect level.
Price wise it is amazing for fresh crab and various seafood.
100% recommend this restaurant and again will be going back.

Kasimira was our host and she was sweet and lovely. We had the lobster deal, 2 x lobster, 2 x sides, 2 x soft drinks for £80 - we did order another side but it didn't come but tbh we were so stuffed we didn't care. Seasoning and spice was ten ten. Would definitely go back.

We ordered the Cajun prawns, 1lb prawns and the calamari with chips. Probably wouldn’t recommend ordering Cajun prawns as a starter if you’re ordering the 1lb prawns, as it’s essentially the same thing. The food was banging! Shame they didn’t have the crabs available at the time we went. Also the gloves they provide to eat were a bit flimsy and annoying. Nevertheless, would deffo come back here again! Service was amazing too, they were very friendly and helpful.

I had dinner at Fat Crab in Stratford for a catch-up with the girls right after the festive season. It was quiet when we went, which we didn't mind. The service was attentive, friendly, and helpful. We asked for recommendations, and they provided great feedback, explaining how the menu works and how we could incorporate different dishes.

I opted for the crab, mussels, and chips. The food was served in a bag without plates, and the tables were covered with disposable tablecloths. We were provided with all the necessary tools to tackle our meal, which was a unique and fun experience. The food was nice but understandably messy. I wouldn't necessarily choose this place for a first date unless you're comfortable with the messiness or don't mind wasting a bit.

The playlist was fantastic, especially if you enjoy RnB (not sure if it's the usual, but we loved it). There's a sink in the restaurant by the bar to wash your hands before and after eating, and they also provide gloves. There are only two bathroom cubicles (from what I saw). It's a short walk from Westfield, heading towards the international train station.

Would I go again? If I was in the area and fancied it, sure! But experienced once so wouldn't necessarily choose.

places.formatted_address: Unit FC2005, The Balcony, Westfield stratford city, Montfichet Rd, London E20 1ES, UK
places.name: Master Bao - Westfield Stratford City

reviews.text:
Early dinner before the theatre.
2nd floor food hall at Westfield shopping centre Stratford. Choice of several restaurants. A friend and I chose the Taiwanese street food place.
I have never previously had Bao's. They were totally delicious. The vegetarian fried rice was a huge portion for one. It was a good thing I was with some hungry girlfriends who helped me polish it off.
If you are not fussy about slumming it with strangers listening to your conversation, and ordering then collecting your food and sitting in a food hall setting, do try this place.

Look out for their offers - 2 Baos, one side and juice for £15!

I got the crispy prawns and the noodle soup. The beef in the noodle soup was really tender but unfortunately the soup was tasteless

EDIT: I decided to try this place again and give the bao a go as it seems to be their main items. Cold fried chicken in a stale bao, and when you pick up the food the staff give you a look like you’re intruding on their private time. Cold service, cold food. Putting this and Taiwanese in the same sentence is a shame

I recently tried the Chicken Dumplings at Master Bao in Westfield Stratford, and they were absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich and authentic, with the perfect balance of texture and taste.

What made the experience even better was the outstanding service. John, the manager, was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. His warm hospitality truly stood out and made our visit memorable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and excellent service!

Beef noodle soup (updated) - Still very good, however very less beef - please add more beef!

Service (updated review) - Excellent customer service from Shruti, really liked her! I wish I had some cash on me, so I could offer it to her for her amazing customer service.

Definitely worth a visit.

Taiwanese cuisine outlet. Have veggie, chicken, prawn options for Bao. The bun was very soft and tasteful. Ordered Chicken and Prawn bao. Crunchy and soft. They have a meal deal. 2 Bao + 1 side and 1 drink (if upgraded). Tried veggie dumplings. Was yummy with dip. Drink was Taiwanese beer (non alcoholic). Bit wierdy taste. Can try at your own risk. The restaurant is located in westgate shopping area in food outlet area. Plenty of sitting options. And lot of other cuisine combo available if going in group. Definitely plenty of paid parking.

places.formatted_address: Between Tariq Halal Meat & Greggs, Unit 49/51, Inside 5 Continents Food Court, The Mall, Stratford Shopping Centre, London E15 1XE, UK
places.name: Aroma Authentic Dum Biriyani

reviews.text: Absolutely loved the experience at Aroma Authentic Dum Biryani. The alfaham was truly authentic and full of rich, delicious flavors. Lime refreshers was taste good. The customer service was excellent, and the staff were very polite and well behaved, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Although the seating area is a bit congested, everything else was spot on from the food quality to the overall service. Highly recommended for biryani lovers
The food is really tasty and the staff if very friendly. Kappa biriyani and tea was what I had and I have had it couple of times here. It has always been yummy.
Portion size really surprised me. Jordi's service was nice. And the chef Liton thank you the food was delicious.
taste of the food is so nice and good, but consider the price quantity is quite low, but it’s okay

Service is too quick and good. The food is so fresh and authentic. The taste is too good. Biryani tastes like Hyderabad biryani.  Dosas are like proper Indian dosas. Best place to eat south Indian food in Stratford.

places.formatted_address: First Floor Level, Olympic Park, Westfield stratford city, Montfichet Rd, London E20 1EJ, UK
places.name: Indi-go Rasoi Westfield Stratford

reviews.text:
Dear Indi-Go Rasoi, if I am going to spend £21.20 on hunters lamb chops and pilau rice, you should be nice enough to not burn my lamb chops.

We all already know that lamb chops doesn’t have as much meat, but over cooking it until it’s burnt and dry (no meat juice) and then serving it is awful, the entire meal tasted bitter because of the burnt ashes on the lamb chops. It was so bad I had to ask for chilli oil from Mrs Chew’s to make the meal taste OKAY!

I can never return to your restaurant to buy anything because this entire experience was awful.

Tried chole bhature here , the curry is burned its overcooked and you can feel it in every bite. Burning smell is so strong But they still served burned curry to customer. Very disappointing, never going to visit again.

Indi-Go Rasoi at Westfield Stratford offers a variety of Indian street food, including dishes like butter chicken, lamb biryani, wraps and various tandoori items. I felt there is a scope for service-related drawbacks. Getting seat for dining will be a challenge especially during peak hours. Was an average dining experience.
I love Indo's street food. Full of flavour. My favourite has to be the Samosa Chaat

Extremely appropriated Indian food. Quantity was alright but there was a general lack of salt and flavour in the paneer wrap. The chutney was sweet too so literally felt like chewing wet sweet bread with paneer and unsalted fries.

places.formatted_address: Lower Level, Westfield, Great Eastern Rd, London E20 1EJ, UK
places.name: Cafe Rasa Malaysia

reviews.text: It is an ideal restaurant to go to eat after being several hours inside the mall, although it is a small restaurant, it is open and very cosy. Their staff is very friendly and attentive. Although I had never tried Malaysian food, I found its menu attractive and very colourful. After ordering I can say that the Malaysian food is delicious, I really liked its presentation, its flavours and aromas. I especially loved the fried chicken because it was delicious and crispy, I loved it. What would improve is the coconut shake, because it is too sweet and the palate becomes cloying, it seems to me that the bottom had toffee or caramel. Soups are also very tasty. Upon leaving the restaurant they were very kind and generous to give us some jack fruit chips typical of Malaysia.

This is the real deal! Excellent authentic Malaysian food with warm and thoughtful service.

I passed by several times and almost all seats were filled, for good reason. Despite the density of tables, the staff ensure you have plenty of space and move things around for you.

We shared roti with chicken curry (delicious and plenty of chicken pieces), king prawn laksa, beef rendang nasi lemak, karipap and chicken rice.

All were delicious and the sambal served with the nasi lemak was perfect (I reckon the owner is well aware, as they also sell jars for you to take home!). The fried chicken skin was paper thin and crisp, served with flavourful chicken rice.

My only gripe is I wished the nasi lemak was served with more beef rendang as the portion was disproportionate to the amount of rice.

The price is higher than the fast food joints around the corner, but is a much better choice by far.

The restaurant is clean, tidy, comfortable, small, bright, sleek, vibrant but no walls for privacy which was not ideal for my friend. The food was delicious, mouthwatering, tasty, colourful, well presented but it can do with more flavour and can do better according to my friend. The staff are friendly, polite, kind, knowledgeable, respectful, understanding, supportive, well mannered, professional and helpful what I liked a lot in this place. The price was £51.22 which includes service charge of £5.02 but food and drink was £46.20 for my friend and I at this place. If you want to go there you can but keep in mind that is small place and it will remind you of Malaysia although you are not in there and you smile when you’re in the restaurant.

Absolute gem of a restaurant in the shopping centre. The food and the decor is top notch with a great courteous staff and the owner of the restaurant is a fantastic person to have a chat with. Also the business is in a positive limelight with the local community was a great piece of information. Staff were great to talk to and felt that I was in Malaysia for a while. The vibes were that good. Thank you!

I ordered the fried chicken leg rice set. The chicken leg itself had a nicely crisp skin, but the meat was bland and lacked any tenderness or bounce. The yellow rice was overly salty and didn’t carry the fragrance or richness of chicken oil that you’d expect. As for the soup, it tasted mainly of star anise and salt, with none of the depth or comforting flavour of real chicken broth. Considering the price, the overall quality felt very disappointing and not worth it.

places.formatted_address: 38 W Ham Ln, London E15 4PT, UK
places.name: Al zayt Restaurant

reviews.text: I have been there with family of four and tried their Beef Koduttam and garlic naan as a stater. We saved the Al Zayt special plater for the mains. The food was good and delicious however we ask for some spice with the a beef Koduttam and was denied. Highly recommend their Lemon juice Jug. That one is 10/10. The tables and cutlery was clean but could be polished and that applies to the glassware as well. Will be back to see if there is any progress. Thanks for having us as a walk-in guest today. Keep up the good work

We had an incredible dining experience! The food was bursting with flavor we ordered the mandi and alfahm chicken, both of which were outstanding. My only suggestion would be to increase the size of the alfahm chicken plate, as the plate was a bit small and made it challenging to enjoy the meal properly. The restaurant was a bit smoky, but the delicious taste made it worth it. We also ordered black tea, which took quite a while to arrive. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I definitely plan to come back!

Tried the Honey Alfaham Mandi and Chicken Pollichathu and both were absolutely flavorful! 🍗🔥 The mandi came with perfectly spiced rice topped with juicy, smoky chicken glazed in a touch of honey – rich and satisfying. The chicken pollichathu was bursting with bold spices, tender meat, and a beautiful hit of herbs. 🌿 Each bite felt like a burst of authentic taste.

If you’re craving a mix of aromatic rice dishes and spicy grilled delights, Alzayt is a must-visit! 🙌

I had the afgani chicken which was absolutely delicious as well as the naan bread! The rice dish was also good but not superior. Atmosphere was okay. All in all still a good experience and would recommend.

The food at Al Zayt Restaurant is absolutely amazing! We regularly order their peri peri, alfaham, and mandi, and it's always so yummy and packed with flavour. While the atmosphere inside can be a bit congested, the staff are very nice and friendly. The delicious food and budget-friendly prices make it our go-to spot. Highly recommend!

places.formatted_address: 219 Leytonstone Rd, London E15 1LN, UK
places.name: FAT CHEF (Authentic Indian Kitchen) Halal

reviews.text: My husband went to collect food today from this Indian takeaway. We ordered a king prawn jalfrazi and chicken vindaloo, and it was absolutely delicious! The food was full of flavour and cooked to perfection. Definitely ordering from Fat Chef again!

Was really yummy. One of the best Indian food’s I’ve had in London, at a really affordable price with big portions and fantastic value for price. Will definitely come again! Delivery was also very quick!
Ordered a few dishes from Fat Chef and Alhamdulillah the food was 10/10 Allahuma Barik and also the customer service was 10/10 would highly recommend

Starballers Academy approached the Fat Chef team to cater for us on two separate occasions. They provided us fantastic services in all aspects even though we requested the orders with short notice. The orders were for 45 people and food was great on both occasions. Their customer service, professionalism and communication was excellent. They exceeded the expectations and executed their services to a high quality. We would recommend Fat Chef to all those requiring catering that is inclusive of tasty food and exceptional customer service.

I recently ordered from Fat Chef and it was a delightful experience. The flavors were authentic, bold, and vibrant, capturing the essence of traditional Indian/bangladeshi cuisine.

If you're craving delicious, authentic Indian food, I highly recommend this place. The dishes were flavorful, portions were generous, and everything was cooked with care. Perfect for a cozy night in or a quick meal on the go. Will definitely be ordering again!

editorial_summary.overview: Handsome, spacious setting for grilled halal Irish beef, seasonal small plates & afternoon tea.

places.formatted_address: 405 High St, London E15 4QZ, UK
places.name: HS & Co

reviews.text: Had a lovely experience here. The food is fantastic, and amazing recommendations from our waiter, Hamid, who recommended us the Honey & Jalapeño chicken wings.  We also had the garlic prawns, and steaks. All of it was a 10/10. The mocktails are amazing too. We also tried the sticky toffee pudding, as recommended by Hamid. Will definitely be coming again. Thank you to all of the staff, and Hamid, for giving us such a lovely anniversary dinner.

Amazing food and service! The rib eye steak was cooked perfectly and the Sunday roast in a Yorkshire pudding was delicious. Also really liked the halloumi fries. Big thanks to Hamid for looking after us so well — highly recommend checking out HS&Co!

I had such a beautiful experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely stunning — every dish was full of flavour, perfectly presented, and clearly made with care. But what truly made the visit special was the service.

There was one guy working on the shop floor, and he was just incredible. So lovely, welcoming, and genuinely kind — his hospitality really stood out. Even though he was running the floor on his own, he was fast, efficient, and so calm under pressure.

A true hidden gem, definitely will be backzx

Absolutely loved this place! The hospitality here is on another level – it was one of the first things that stood out for me. Ahmed was outstanding, super welcoming and really knew what to recommend – his suggestions were spot on. The food was delicious, full of flavour, and everything is halal so no worries there at all. They’ve even got a prayer space, which just shows the extra thought and care put into the experience. Overall, hospitality gets a 10/10 from me. Can’t wait to come back again – this place is a gem!

Beautiful restaurant with great atmosphere and decor! We ordered two mocktails one was a cherry one with lime and the other was mint mocktail both drinks were amazing ! For the starters we had ghost wings and calamari which was amazing for the mains we had beef roast dinner and baked salmon both were very good very filling all in all good food for amazing pricing and would defo be returning again the staff were excellent friendly and helpful.

editorial_summary.overview: Beef-centric menu with an array of cuts, sauces, & sides in a relaxed setting with cozy booths.

places.formatted_address: 150 The Grove, London E15 1NS, UK
places.name: Steakout Stratford

reviews.text: I’ve eaten here a few times now, and to be honest it has been very consistent. The steaks are always cooked exactly how I like them and the flavours are fantastic. Customer service is also very good. I can’t really fault this place. It is a little pricey but it’s not an everyday thing. The meat is all halal.

recently had the beef steak here, and honestly, it was one of the best I’ve had in a long time. The steak came out perfectly cooked…juicy, tender, and full of flavor with every bite. You can tell they really know how to handle good quality meat and cook it just right. It wasn’t overdone or underdone, just spot on, which is rare to find these days.

The portion size was generous, and it felt like real value for money considering the quality. The seasoning was simple but balanced, letting the natural flavor of the beef shine through. I didn’t feel like it was drowned in sauces or overcomplicated …..it was just a proper, well-executed steak.

The sides complemented the meal really well too, fresh and not greasy. Together with the steak, it made for a satisfying plate that leaves you full but not heavy.

Service-wise, everything was smooth. The staff were friendly, attentive, and quick without being intrusive, which makes a big difference when you’re out to enjoy a meal. The atmosphere of the place added to the experience cozy, welcoming, and comfortable enough to sit back and enjoy without feeling rushed.

Overall, this is the kind of spot I’d recommend to anyone who appreciates a good steak. It’s definitely worth coming back for, and I’ll be doing exactly that. If you’re in the area and craving beef cooked properly, this place won’t disappoint.

Ok wow
What an experience- we didn’t know what to expect. The place was dead. To put it politely. Although it was a Monday night. There were a few people in for deliveries but yeah. They also had no Coca Cola or Pepsi, so we had the new thing. It was great.
The pictures will tell the story but only so much. The food here is fantastic: Layla served us, she was so attentive throughout, entertaining and charming. Really lovely young lady
Now for the starter - I had the Nachos with oozing cheese and spinach- this reinvented the concept of nachos for us. And we aren’t going back to crisps on a plate with splodges - this is the only way to have them.
Mike, my love, he had the onion rings, these were hand made, crispy batter with a lovely sauce.
Then for the meat, we both had lamb with the house sauce and it was unbelievable and excellent value as well especially for the area.
Highly recommended

In terms of atmosphere that was all fine. No music playing which is what I prefer and the place wasn't loud. The waiters don't annoy you. I liked the atmosphere very much.

The service was great. Everyone was helpful and accommodating. I did make a small complaint about the chips which I'll elaborate on later but the guy just said okay and did nothing about that which I thought was poor hence the 4/5 star rating. Besides that it deserves a 5.
