The chips were perfectly salted (not too much or too little), they were crispy and they still had the skin on them! Their choice of drinks is out of the ordinary. This place stands out from your usual eating places! I’d give more stars if I could!

My mates and bro told me their consistency of great food is always on point, so I’d definitely recommended if you’re in the area. And if you’re not in the area then I recommend you to travel here to try this place! It’s worth your time and every bite!

Title: Disappointing Food, Pleasant Environment

Rating: ⭐⭐

Review:
I recently visited Andy's Bangin Burger and ordered their beef single burger with fries. Unfortunately, I was quite disappointed with the overall quality of the food. The meat was overcooked. I can’t feel I am having a burger. It’s taste like something else.The fries were burnt and lacked the crispy texture I was expecting. They tasted like they had been sitting around for a while, almost like very old fries.

On the positive side, I must commend the restaurant's environment, which was pleasant and inviting. The staff members were friendly and accommodating, which made the experience more enjoyable.

While I appreciate the positive aspects of my visit, the subpar quality of the food significantly impacted my overall satisfaction. I hope that Andy's Bangin Burger takes this feedback into consideration and works on improving the consistency and taste of their food.

places.formatted_address: 237 Mile End Rd, Bethnal Green, London E1 4AA, UK
places.name: Mr Wong’s Wok & Box ️

reviews.text: Thank you Lina for such a wonderful experience today. She had a big smile on her face and gave us a warm welcome. We came in with only half hour to spare, and told her that at the tills. She took our order and we received the food super quick, everything was fresh, piping hot and so delicious. My kids enjoyed it a lot, this was my first time coming here and will definitely come again.

unbelievabley small portions with boxes barely covering the bottom. Paid 7-10 a dish spending over £50 and hardly anything in the boxes. daylight robbery. tried calling them to discuss but there's no telephone number on the receipt or google. really disappointed.

Really enjoyed the atmosphere — very nicely decorated. The bao buns were quite nice, and the BBQ wings were definitely a highlight. The chicken fried rice was perfect, full of flavor and cooked just right.

The dynamite chicken was a bit on the oily side, and the calamari didn’t quite meet expectations, but overall still a great experience.

Service definitely needs improvement. Drinks were not available we had to go to the corner shop to get our own drinks and items on the order where missed.

⭐☆☆☆☆

I honestly can’t believe this place. Paid £16 for a meal that wouldn’t even fill a 5-year-old. The portion was ridiculously small – max 8 bites in the whole box. For that price, it’s an absolute joke.

The food itself was a disaster. It smelled like raw masala, had no proper seasoning, and tasted completely bland. The "vegetable" part was practically non-existent – you’d need a magnifying glass to find any. For something advertised as a veg spring roll and rice box, it was missing both quality and actual content.

Completely overpriced, tasteless, and stingy with portions. This was one of the most disappointing takeaway experiences I’ve had. Definitely not worth the money or the hype.

Madeline and Marouan were exceptionally hospitable. This Chinese restaurant is HMC certified.

The food is phenomenal and delicious and super flavorful. When you come here bring your appetite and time to enjoy it!

We ordered the following items.

1) Noodles with mixed meat - hot
2) Crispy Chilli Beef
3) Beef Brisket Bao Bun
4) Singapore Fired Rice with Chicken
5) Passion fruit Drink
6) Lime Drink

editorial_summary.overview: Classic & creative Thai dishes alongside traditional English pies with a kids menu & happy hour.

places.formatted_address: 45 Mile End Rd, Bethnal Green, London E1 4TT, UK
places.name: Thai n Pie Stepney

reviews.text:
Lovely Little Spot in Bethnal Green

Thai and Pie is a small and intimate place, perfect for a casual meal. The service was quick and efficient, and the staff were polite and helpful throughout. You get a nice view of the kitchen through a glass panel, which adds a sense of transparency and trust to the experience.

I had the prawn red Thai curry with Thai rice, and my partner had the beef green Thai curry. The staff even recommended the best rice to go with each dish, which made a real difference. Both dishes were full of flavour, with just the right amount of spice—not too hot, but with enough kick to be enjoyable and still very edible.

The atmosphere could do with a bit more ambience to match the quality of the food, but overall it was a good experience. I’d definitely go back and would recommend others to try it too—especially the curries!
Quality of food has definitely declined. Chicken satay were rubbery, calamari tasted frozen. The pie crust was good however there wasn’t much filling and the gravy was watery rather than thick.
This is the best drunken noodles I’ve ever eaten. My husband loves his noodles as well. Delicious! The server was attentive and helpful. Will absolutely return when in the city again.

Nice food… good flavourings .. everything we ordered was really nice

Only issue was service wasn’t the best.. the fact you add service charge means your service should be impeccable

Asking us to reside dirty cutlery for our mains is a little lazy

No other complaints …
Really enjoyed the experience. Steak was cooked to perfection and juicy. Valentine Pie was also tasty, would definitely go there again

places.formatted_address: 106 Roman Rd, Globe Town, London E2 0RN, UK
places.name: Gansu Bethnal Green

reviews.text: Thank you so much for making my food in 2 minutes! I appreciate you knew I was in a rush and the service was still fantastic. Thank you head chef! I bought the chicken and shrimp fried rice, the food is as good as it looks Alhamdulilah! Hope to come back soon!

This would have got a 5 star but there was not enough sauce on the dynamite bites, bigger box needed so the sauce is evenly spread, couldn’t taste the dynamite taste (decent portion of chicken). Special chow mein was delicious, chips were okay but portion debatable. Shredded beef was delicious, flavour was on point BUT more batter than beef. This is good feedback so you can make it better next time, defo would return again ☺️

Gansu is a delightful little hidden gem.

We’ve visited a couple of times now
& The service is always excellent.

However, They had forgotten
To give King Prawns last time
& So this time they were
Kind enough to give some

Salt & Pepper King Prawns to try
With our Salt & Pepper chips
& Curry Sauce.

They also gave Mum some
Prawn crackers, That she loves.

Everything was on point taste wise
& The portions were generous.

We wish Gansu all the best
& Look forward to visiting
Regularly, As always.

Absolutely Delicious! A Must-Try Spot for Chinese Food Lovers

I had an amazing experience at Gansu! From start to finish, everything was spot on.
The prawn toast was perfectly crisp on the outside and packed with flavor inside — not greasy at all, which is a rarity! The chicken balls were light, golden, and came with a tangy sweet & sour sauce that was just right. The salt and pepper wings were the highlight — incredibly crispy, well-seasoned, and full of that irresistible savory kick with a bit of heat.

Portions were generous, and everything tasted freshly made. You can tell they use quality ingredients and care about getting the flavors just right.

Highly recommend this place — I’ll definitely be coming back!

Tried a Halal authentic Chinese restaurant and loved it! I ordered special fried rice, beef fried rice, and chicken chow mein. Everything was fresh and flavorful, but the beef fried rice was definitely my favorite it was very flavorful and perfectly cooked! Great taste and very reasonable prices. Will definitely come back!

places.formatted_address: 367 Commercial Rd, Stepney Green, London E1 2PS, UK
places.name: Get Stuffed Stepney

reviews.text: Went to try the Brisket taco and it was worth every penny! Also ordered the brisket with creamy mushroom on chips and 6 wings. Brother who served us was really nice and generously upgraded our 6 wings to 10!!! Really nice gesture!! Thank you! Definitely worth a visit!
The Sunday roast was really tasty and super filling! The chicken was a bit dry, but the staff member who helped us was awesome.

Went in for little snack with my sister and ended up being pleasantly surprised by how good the food was. Super clean, calm atmosphere and extremely delicious food, made fresh.
The smash burger tacos were phenomenal! I'd most definitely visit again.

This definitely surpassed my expectations. The food was amazing, really tasty and the service was quick.

The gents at the front were very polite and helpful.

I will definitely visit this place again. Highly recommend it!

Get Stuffed is a gem within Tower Hamlets that I’ve been to many times and I am happy to say, I have always left with a positive experience.

Their expanding menu introduces something new to try every couple of months and it’s always a welcome addition, most recently their Tacos were introduced and I’ve finally found a new favourite after sticking to Burgers for the last 2 years. The extra dish of sauce they give with the tacos really enhances the flavour and it really is a must try.

The Sunday Roast is the best I’ve tried and I have taken everyone I know within my friends and family to try it too and they have all been impressed. The lamb option is my personal favourite. It’s a lovely ‘at home’ feel, surrounded by good food and a busy shop sharing the same experience together.

The customer service is second to none, the brothers who work here treat everyone like family, always serve customers with a smile and I can personally attest to their good nature. If it was not for the amazing food, I would still come here for the service I receive from the staff 100%. Customer service goes a long way in the experience and the staff at Get Stuffed are an excellent example of that.

Definitely a place to visit and try if you haven’t already.

places.formatted_address: Unit 1F, 373 Mentmore Terrace, London E8 3DQ, UK
places.name: Papi Restaurant

reviews.text: Papi mixes the freshest of produce with ingenious flavor combinations! It’s all plated beautifully and served with a friendly smile. The cucumber dish is a must, and so is the corn with the garlic butter! Do not skip the dessert because there is no better way to end the meal at Papi 🤌🏽

Wife and I went for lunch a few weeks ago and we had a blast!

Relaxed vibe with a killer playlist - a table got up an danced it was that good. The food is magnificent, but not pretentious at all.

One of the things that made our experience great, was for that weekend only they were doing a fun thing where you could order 'a glass of wine' and then you get whatever the next bottle to be open is. So we had a different wine every time and they were all fantastic! I think they should do this all the time as it's just fun. Sure, I could open a wine list and order a different glass every time, but this was 'okay the next wine is...'. which made it a very memorable experience.

I ordered two of the same puddings and I don't regret it.

The only thing I'd say is it was a bit spenny. We had the Nightkey app and even then it was on the pricey side. But that being said, I have every intention of going again.

Wow! The best taramasalata I've ever had, and that was the dish I almost didn't order!
An amazing Saturday night dinner, every dish was simply delicious, some of the very best food I've had in London for a long time.

Chef, Matthew is cooking up a storm in this great restaurant that I'm delighted is so local to our home and is supported by charming and attentive staff who do a fine job of looking after the diner.

My only regret is that it took us too long to get round to eating here before, I very much hope it won't be long before we get to enjoy a return visit!

I'm sorry I didn't photograph my food - I was way too busy enjoying it!

As much as I was excited to finally try on Papi restaurant, as much I’ve been disappointed of my experience there. We started with the £1 Oysters and we can’t really complain on such a bargain.
My partner and I ordered a main + a salad. That’s when things get messy. His plate has been served while I’ve been waiting 15+ minutes for my fish to arrive. There’s nothing worse to spend an evening out for dinner but not being able to eat together… It would have been so simple to get the fish ready first to serve it with the vegetables main of my partner and the side salad we ordered.
The staff were cute but the experience was already ruined…

Look - this place is simply outstanding. Go there as soon as possible. I have no idea why it's not always completely packed (I have only been at lunchtime). The depth of flavour on every dish is on point, it's an imaginative menu, and the wine list is honestly cray cray. Charlie in front of house is a treasure. If you like fab small plates and great wines you should add it to your list. Just thinking about it now - the lovely bitter taste of the radicchio. the taramasalata made with trout roe, served with some of the best french fries i have ever had. but dear lord that taramasalata. one of those things i always think i should like, way more than i actually do. here's it's just delicious. the basque cheese cake. oh my days. book a table.

places.formatted_address: 120-122 Morning Ln, London E9 6LH, UK
places.name: DALLA

reviews.text: I loved this restaurant! Every detail was authentic from the subtle elegant design to the beautifully executed food. This chef understands Italian food to its core. It’s about letting ingredients sing without pretentious flourishes. I felt like I was transported to a discovered gem in Milano but happily for me  it’s in London.

The service is OK but the food is lacklustre. Was recommended the zucchini omelette with balsamic vinegar but if you're familiar with Southeast Asian omelette this dish basically just tastes like that... nothing special so just skip it (mine came with eggshells). Seasoning of the mains (fish and pork collar) was very unbalanced. Both were too salty. Desserts were the highlight. Unfortunately for the price and the expectations, I would not recommend this place.

Where to begin?! The food was impeccable. Everyone in the know when it comes to excellent food in London has been raving about Dalla. I can see why. Everything was unbelievably good and it’s one of the best meals I’ve had in London recently.
I highly recommend the anchovy and butter toast and the sea bass with cucumber and caper mayonnaise. Also, do not sleep on the pumpkin tortelli, it’s one of the best I’ve had!
I liked that the coffee in the tiramisu was not too strong and the sour grape syrup that comes with the panna cotta is so unique. I wasn’t sure about it at first but grew to like it.

The only downside is that the waiters were a little cold. I tried my hardest to be friendly but the service was not very warm. However, tall guy with facial hair, who I think is the head chef, was very smiley and welcoming so that was nice. He stands at the front as you enter and you can see him plating everything if you have the right table which was fun to see.
I’ll definitely be back! A reservation is definitely required - it’s a very popular spot!

Dalla is a charming, intimate spot with a cosy atmosphere and a tightly curated menu that leans into simplicity and quality. While the service can feel a little chaotic at times — likely due to inexperience — the staff are warm and well-intentioned.

The gnudi toscani was a true highlight: light, delicate, and full of flavour. The tagliata di manzo delivered on taste, though the meat was noticeably tough, which let the dish down a touch.

Dalla shows real promise, but it’s not quite up there yet with more polished Italian favourites like Trullo or Bocca di Lupo. That said, it’s an enjoyable experience and worth a visit — especially for the gnudi.

5 stars are just not enough to express our love for the restaurant and people there.

We always come to Dalla whenever we travel to London. You can never go wrong with anything on the menu and their daily specials. With seasonal food and wine, they always surprise us with the best food!

Their service is impeccable too! Lovely people running the restaurant with love and passion. My boyfriend planned a proposal there and they just nailed everything with a wonderful personal touch! Thanks Gen, Gian and Gianluca for calling London another home so much easier!

editorial_summary.overview: Inventive tapas dishes from Southern Spain to North Africa, served in buzzy, colorful quarters.

places.formatted_address: 195 Hackney Rd, London E2 8JL, UK
places.name: Morito

reviews.text: A pretty exquisite meal in a cool restaurant. We were able to walk-in with relative ease for a counter table on a Friday night. Menu is quite extensive, would highly recommend the hummus, tortilla and lamb chops. The suelovivo bottle of red was also delightful. Will be returning.

Amazing experience. Shakira welcomed me in a fantastic way, and the group of close-knit people organized a wonderful dinner. Spanish and North African flavors, new ways to taste food and learn about different cultures. I must say I’m really satisfied—I highly recommend this experience!

Very cool vibe in this open space restaurant with open kitchen and bar in the middle. Staff is very friendly and food is fantastic! I'd recommend to get the fries aubergine with the feta cream (too good to be true) and the pan con tomate! The chocolate mousse with olive oil is an interesting twist which I'd also recommend to try! Overall I do recommend it!

Interesting blend of Spanish and eastern Mediterranean styles. We had a very good Chardonnay from Morocco. Great attentive service from a French student. Nice multicultural vibe friendly for a cool restaurant in London.

this one is a favourite! bf took me there to celebrate my birthday and we had the best food/cocktails! so amazed we barely took any pictures 😂 will definitely go back there! only critic is that the food arrived all at once, with no time between the dishes… so next time i would order 2 or 3 dishes and then continue to order after finishing those. good service overall and cute ambiance!

places.formatted_address: 460 Hackney Rd, London E2 9EG, UK
places.name: Rogues.

reviews.text: Went for an early dinner on a Wednesday evening just before the place got busy. Delicious tasting menu and reasonably priced for the quality of dishes served. The whipped ricotta dish with radicchio, roasted beets, and maraschino cherries was delicious. The sourdough with pâté and fresh oysters with pickled radish were also personal favorites. Last but not least, the staff were friendly and accommodating in seating us earlier than our booked reservation. Thank you to the team at Rogues. for a wonderful dinner ☺️

Phenomenal!!! Service was brilliant along with the wine options(hard to choose) and food melted in your mouth which exceptional flavours. We did the tasting menu for £69 each which I highly recommend. Great serving size as often you are either too full or leave hungry but this place understands the brief. It was my partners birthday and they did a candle and little card for him which is the sweetest touch! Appreciate the filtered  unlimited water for £1 with the bottle of water  being left on your table as often I am always asking for water at restaurants as they don’t want to leave it with you or charge you over price fee. Have wanted to try this places for a long time and it lived up to expectations. Travels an hour to get here as I live south and well and truely worth it 💕💕

A delightful restaurant, with a fun, inventive menu and helpful service. As a three on a week night we all had the set menu, with one vegan and one pescetarion option. The staff were helpful, accommodating and  looked after us well.

The food was excellent. A lot of thought has clearly gone into the dishes and they were well executed. The menu was extensive and we left very full.

Went for dinner and got the set menu. Amazing food, attentive service and overall very pleasant atmosphere. The menu changes constantly according to what’s in season, which makes this a great place to come back to for seconds!

One of the best restaurants in London, deserves a star and will get it soon so go here before you can’t get a reservation. Extremely accommodating with allergies. Fantastic cocktails and wine. The level of service was 10/10 outstanding. We shall return. Shout outs to Caitlin for her kind warm welcome and the extremely attentive English waitress (sorry we didn’t get your name)

editorial_summary.overview: Natural wine, modern small plates & wood-fired pizza are the draws at this hip farm-to-table eatery.

places.formatted_address: 121-123 Mare St, London E8 4RH, UK
places.name: Elliot’s - South Hackney

reviews.text:
We had a great time here catching up with friends, such a lovely vibe and amazing service.
The food was overall good, the 1/2 chicken, grilled pork chop, crab pizza, cheese puffs and corn polenta was amazing.
Was a little disappointed by some of the small plates (ricotta with tomatoes and melon with green beans), didn’t think the ingredients went that well together.

We celebrated a birthday at Elliot’s in Hackney and opted for the set menu. The portion sizes were generous, which was a pleasant surprise, and we really enjoyed both the flavors and the presentation of each dish. The only downside was that our group of 15 was seated alongside other guests, which may have been a bit loud and distracting for them. That said, the overall experience was excellent, and we left feeling very happy with our evening.

Been meaning to come here for a long time and was so impressed! My partner and I got the DIVINE cheese puffs which are like little bites of cheesy heaven, a refreshing and lemony mozzarella small plate and the highlight of the seabass and monkfish mains. Beautiful dishes with amazing flavour!!
Wine was delicious and service from our lovely curly haired waitress was great.
It's not a cheap meal but the quality is worth it.

Glad I revisited Elliot’s for the second time as I wasn’t a fan after the first time. Highlights were the cheese puffs, oyster mushroom, monkfish & potato flatbread. Didn’t order those the last time I visited & was blown away! Loved the hackney location too - super vibey and great service. Only letdown were the cocktails which we found a little too imbalanced but the wine selection was great & more than made up for it.

YUMMM ✨
Elliot’s definitely surpassed all expectations! My friend and I really enjoyed the food as well as the vibesss
The chicken was the absolute king of the night, being cooked to perfection and melting as soon as you bite into it. The cheese puffs and flatbread were also great. The broad beans were the right choice of light side as well!
Loved it and will definitely be back!

editorial_summary.overview: Stylish, contemporary hangout crafting breakfast & lunch, including baked goods & gourmet plates.

places.formatted_address: 32 Andrews Rd, London E8 4FX, UK
places.name: Cafe Cecilia

reviews.text: We had a wonderful lunch at Cafe Cecilia. Each dish was delicious and packed with flavours. We really enjoyed the sage  & anchovy fritti, the mozzarella & figs, the lemon sole and the pork leg. Attentive and friendly service. A must-visit restaurant in east London!!

an amazing meal. the bread and butter was lovely (especially the guinness bread), and the onglet was incredible. the sauce was so good we scraped it all up!! the deep fried bread pudding alone definitely is worth coming for.

From start to finish, a perfect meal. We had the sage and anchovy and the zucchini flower starters, both bursting with flavor. For our mains, the ravioli was perfection on a plate, and the Guinea fowl special with sweet corn and the wing rib were absolutely delectable. For dessert, the Guinness ice cream exceeded my expectations, and the deep-fried bread and butter was the perfect ending to our meal.

Everything we had in Cafe Cecilia was perfection, I had so much of their bread and butter it's embarrassing, then stuffed zucchini flower, guineafowl with polenta, sage stuffed with anchovies which was attacked immediately so no photo available, wing rib steak and chips, bone marrow, zucchini pasta,  deep fried bread and butter pudding and Guinness bread ice-cream is a MUST. Chef is talented and it's clear that he loves what he does. Give it a go, I promise, you will enjoy every second of it.

Even in such a crowded French-inspired-British-classics and nose-to-tail restaurant scene, Cafe Cecilia manages to stand out. Each dish was exceptional: the flavours are familiar but everything felt elevated — because of how well-executed each dish is and the quality of the ingredients. The standout dishes were the mackerel and the bread pudding. I don’t have the exact statistics but just based on my own experiences of dining out, this is one of the rare restaurants where at least half the chef are women.

editorial_summary.overview: Creative fusion fare combining Japanese & Italian flavors in a sophisticated dining room.

places.formatted_address: 56 Dalston Ln, London E8 3AH, UK
places.name: Angelina

reviews.text:
Absolutely outstanding. Loved every second of our experience here - food is divine, menu put together beautifully. The fusion of japanese and italian was a dream come true. Every dish was delicious and the service was amazing - staff were so attentive. Wine also paired and presented beautifully.

My friend had the regular menu while I had the vegetarian and I was honestly amazed at how beautiful it all was and how attentive they were to this too!

We sat at the chefs counter and it was such a great experience to watch food being prepared. Such a cosy interior too with comfortable seating.

Will definitely be coming back & highly recommend.

Overall, our dining experience was ok, but several aspects could be improved to bring it in line with the standards expected of a fine dining establishment and improve the value for the ££££.
1.	Temperature of Dishes: A few dishes were not served at the optimal temperature. The Wagyu beef, in particular, arrived lukewarm, and the bread was served cold, which diminished the enjoyment of what should have been standout moments in the meal.
2.	Order of Service: The sequence of dishes felt somewhat confusing. For instance, the Wagyu dish might have been better placed before or alongside the main course rather than being a 2nd dish. A more coherent flow between courses would create a smoother and more balanced dining experience.
3.	Wine Pairing: While we appreciated the effort to pair wines with different courses, service coordination fell short. At one point, the wine intended for the main tuna dish was delayed, leaving us waiting while the dish cooled. Timeliness here is essential to maintaining both flavor and flow.
4.	Starters and Desserts: The starters, though clearly made with fresh ingredients, lacked depth and strong flavor. The desserts were particularly underwhelming — the tiramisu, for example, felt one-dimensional and uninspired. The restaurant would greatly benefit from working with a dedicated dessert chef to develop more inventive flavor combinations and refined takes on classic Japanese or Italian sweets.
5.	Service Charge: Finally, it was disappointing to see a 15% service charge automatically added to the bill. While the service was good, it did not reach the level of attentiveness and polish that would justify such a substantial, non-optional charge — particularly in a fine dining setting, where guests expect both excellence and transparency.

The restaurant has great potential — beautiful presentation, high-quality ingredients, and an appealing concept of Italian Japanese fusion. With more attention to temperature, course sequencing, wine service, and menu refinement, alongside a more considered approach to service charges, the overall experience could easily reach the exceptional standard it aspires to.

Sophisticated fine dining venue that works beautifully for special occasions, even with larger groups. The tasting menu cleverly weaves Asian aromatics into Italian foundations. Cocktails and tea service bookend the meal nicely.

The smoked focaccia and strawberry-sauced raw fish were our evening's highlights - creative and expertly executed. The pasta course was excellent, though the grilled quail felt somewhat predictable for this calibre of menu. One of the starters being another fried item seemed like a missed opportunity for more variety.

For the price point, it delivers solid value and a memorable experience. Staff are exceptional - knowledgeable about every dish and genuinely passionate. Arrive early and you might snag counter seats with kitchen views, which adds to the experience.

It was our first tasting-menu experience and it was mind blowing. Both the food and the wine pairing were absolutely outstanding. The staff was very professional, friendly and detail-oriented.

The 13 dishes menu was outstanding, discovering new flavours with each bite, and the explanations from the staff were excellent.

We were on the dinning room, on a corner that was quite private for ourselves so we could have a nice conversation in a very comfortable environment.

We were celebrating an important occasion and we got a wine glass on the house and some candles with the dessert course. They treated us very well, we will always remember it!

2pax dinner on 25.7.2025

@Angelina Restaurant

came with good expectations japanese italian omakase 13dishes £68pax

the place was packed, always a good thing. F&B a tough business, always good to see support of customers.

service by the young, cheerful, bright serving staff was excellent.

for ourselves though, went away kind of unsatisfied….

3 appertisers - a bread, a lamb karraage, furai fritters etc.. ok, competent not quite fine dining dishes..ok, need reset expectations vs the price.

crudo and pane - foccacia good, amadai good sashimi, sweet and fresh, sauce neither here nor there not quite our liking, a simple truffle kampachi type would be better for us. summer salad ordinary, sesame sauce heavy, ok not great by our preference.

chawanmushi has good hotate (scallops) and truffle, competent texture, for us missing the natural broth sweetness in most jap restaurants.

chawanmushi served in a completely chipped ramekin 体无完肤.

the ravioli? was good, great pasta, good sauce.

pigeon sous vide grilled on binchotan best dish, excellent taste and perfect texture, pink and nice bbq flavours. sauce was rich, tasty, not sure the best match for the pigeon. tiny shrimps ok doesn’t add any dimension to the dish? confit fig was good.

desserts/petit four pretty good.

editorial_summary.overview: Hip, industrial-chic pizzeria with a 'disco ball' oven, for brunch, drinks and Italian small plates.

places.formatted_address: Unit 3, 201 Richmond Rd, London E8 3NJ, UK
places.name: LARDO

reviews.text: They are amazing! We went there with a toddler, so it was a bit challenging but the waiter and the servers helped us a lot, in managing the table and making our toddler entertained. They were so helpful, kind and polite. We, my friend and her baby had fun a lot although he made a bit of a mess around. The food was amazing, we ordered beetroot salad, pizza, red wine and tiramisu. It was so delicious! Especially we lived tiramisu because it tasted closer to the original recipe with almond liqueur. We sat outside, the weather was amazing and everything was perfect. I would recommend this place to everyone!

New Yorker/New Jerseyan here- this place. is. it.

The mafalde is absolutely delectable. It is the simplest meal made up of a handful of ingredients but oh my— the freshness?? unreal.

The margherita pizza STUNNED with a classic cheesy, greasy (in a good way) finish, you really can’t ask for more. Even the vegan pizza was delicious, and a quick ricotta sub (i took olives off my half) made it the perfect meal.

Excellent vibes, both indoor & outdoor, & excellent food. Cannot recommend it more! Will be back xx

We had a fantastic experience at Lardo in Hackney! The food was absolutely delicious—each dish was well-prepared and full of flavor. The pizza had the perfect balance of a crispy crust and rich toppings. The fresh, high-quality ingredients really shined in every plate we tried. The ambiance was cozy and inviting, making it a great spot for a relaxed meal. The staff were also friendly and attentive. Definitely a place worth visiting if you’re in East London!

Had a dinner here for a family members birthday party. The service was amazing! Had an amazing server who was wonderful.
The pizza's, pastas and focaccia were delicious! However the arancini and potatoes were.... not up to standard.

Nonetheless wonderful evening was had there !
Amazing dining experience in a great location. The ambiance and service were top notch and the food was hard to beat. Standouts are the Carpaccio, Artichoke Heart (new) and Carbonara pizza

places.formatted_address: 221 Well St, London E9 6RG, UK
places.name: Shankeys

reviews.text:
Shankeys never misses! I have been twice this year and would definitely say it is my top restaurant in 2025. The cauli cheese is out of this world! The service is also amazing with the staff being super attentive and always ensuring you are enjoying your meal. Prices are super reasonable and not overpriced even tho it is a small plates restaurant - which is super rare in London!

The only thing I did not enjoy the last 2 times I have been are the potatoes- they don’t take my fancy but that is just a personal preference!

I will be back soon!

I was out with my niece for a chat and drinks.  Always passed this place for many
years, just thought it was a type of cafe. We popped in not realising it was a booking system.  They allowed us in, and we had an amazing experience. Service was excellent, food was very delicious even though we just had snacking plates. Drinks 🍸 were tops I will definitely, returning as I live 2mins away. Have to take my sister think she would like it. I tried oysters for the first time it was a lovely explosion of flavours.
A gem restaurant on my doorstep.
Omg those oysters!!! Would come back just for those… our other stand out dish was the veggie sharing plate! A lovely ambience and vibe! Will be back for sure
The food and drinks selection was amazing and really reasonably priced. The staff were really attentive and personable. Would 100% recommend visiting if you can. Everything we had was delicious!
Delicious! Amazing food, drinks and service - I would absolutely come back here and recommend it to anybody in a heartbeat!

places.formatted_address: 396 Mare St, London E8 1HP, UK
places.name: Narrow Kitchen

reviews.text: Y’all. Drop everything and come here for brunch. This is hands down the best chili labneh eggs I have ever had. Wonderful service, chill vibes. I’m coming back!

I can honestly say I have just had the best avocado, poached egg and feta cheese on sourdough. If I could give 11/10 I would. Amazing food ❤️ lovely, friendly staff, clean surroundings and great prices ❤️ thank you so much xxx
Without a doubt the best eggs I’ve ever had. I think I might move here so this can be my local. A lovely unassuming cafe restaurant, that DELIVERS THE GOODS. Get in my face 😋

Simply the best place in Hackney for brunch! I’m not really an egg person but the Chilli Labneh Eggs is one of the best dishes I’ve ever eaten. The focaccia is all home made and absolutely delicious. Top tier coffee and all at reasonable prices. Could not recommend enough.

Great food and staff, despite the rebrand of the name- new dishes as much as the old ones (my fav foccacia pictured) are scrumptious! 4 stars because my fresh orange juice I got later was definitely not fresh- not bits in sight! Its ok if its not just don’t put it on the menu as such…

editorial_summary.overview: Intimate restaurant preparing refined seasonal fare from locally sourced ingredients.

places.formatted_address: 158 Sandringham Rd, London E8 2HS, UK
places.name: Casa Fofó

reviews.text: Nice food. Some dishes were over salty. I ordered 3 non-alcoholic drinks to rinse my palette in addition to water. The lamb in the main dish was rather too small to properly taste and enjoy. In general, the design of the tasting menu was good though, but the saltiness was probably due to the prepared sauce and ingredients getting too condensed when re-heated. The chef should have easily resolved the problem by testing and tasting while cooking and before serving from time to time.

We had a private experience for a friends 30th. We were looked after so well and the food was absolutely remarkable. I would also say it was playful and exciting with the flavours. It’s a seasonal menu so depending when you you might have totally different options. I’d recommend the orange wine and white wines. It was an unforgettable evening and the team and chefs are so professional. Would love to go back if my purse can handle it!

Came for dinner with two friends and everything about our experience was perfect. The staff were incredible friendly and so knowledgeable about the menu. The restaurant its self is so beautiful and the open kitchen is such a lovely experience to watch the chef cook away! The food was absolutely incredible from start to finish I was blown away, It’s a set menu and each course was different and so interesting! The wine list is incredible and the homemade kombucha is something special, Highly recommend to everyone !

I wasn’t overly amazed by the food and felt that a few dishes were a little too salty and had clashing flavours.
The kitchen was kind enough to cater to a vegetarian diner that was part of our party, and made a different set menu for them (we informed/asked them in advance about this).
The atmosphere was quite nice. The open kitchen and fact that it’s tucked away on a random street in Hackney sets the scene for a relaxed setting.

Have been wanting to try this place for ages and keep putting it off because of where it is located. We were both really impressed about the tasting menu, very innovative cuisine with combination of flavors that we haven’t tried before. The sichuan peppercorn pasta gives a subtle kick while compliments the rest really well.
Great value tasting menu (even more shocked to find services already included). Decent wine list. The menu changes often so we can’t wait to be back.

places.formatted_address: 437 Hackney Rd, London E2 8PP, UK
places.name: Mama Restaurant London

reviews.text: Great experience - we went here for our anniversary, & our dog’s birthday! Everyone working was lovely, so friendly! Made us, & our dog feel incredibly welcome! They gave our puppy a free glass of wine! Free meal! And a nice plate for her birthday! And us a free dessert for our anniversary! And the Sunday roasts 👌 beef wellington was excellent, & there was so much meat on the half roast chicken! So worth the money, we will be back! I think it’s our dogs new favourite place!

Great vibes at Mama Restaurant London! The atmosphere is relaxing with a really nice selection of music that sets the tone. The food was tasty, and if you’ve got a sweet tooth, don’t skip dessert — absolutely worth it.

Very friendly and welcoming staff, super nice food, drinks and the atmosphere was so great. We went for brunch just before Christmas and it was lovely decorated, music played was very disco-vibe which we loved! Recommend the spicy margaritas and ribs. The best tiramisu I have had in London! Will definitely return.
YUMMY. Staff are all so sweet and the food is wayyy better than any hotel restaurant has the right to be lol

Had an amazing experience celebrating Yassmine’s birthday! The staff was incredibly welcoming, and they even treated us to prosecco on the house. We enjoyed four delicious hamburgers, each one better than the last! The atmosphere was fantastic, making it the perfect spot for a casual special occasion. Highly recommend!

places.formatted_address: 177 Morning Ln, London E9 6LH, UK
places.name: Big Night Bar & Restaurant Hackney

reviews.text: Randomly booked a place and where pleasantly surprised. Little quirky place with a nice decor, funky music and amazing drinks. We had pretty much everything on the menu and enjoyed their pickles and skewers (tasty bread was ordered several times too). Service was attentive and we got convinced to try tongue skewer which was absolutely delicious. If you want some fun drinks, interesting food and quirky atmosphere this place is for you. Will be back:)

Had a lovely evening with great food however felt pretty ripped off when we received the receipt. I consciously ordered off your board menu which clearly said “House £5” therefore I ordered a house white, twice, and later found out that I was charged £10 per glass of wine… my friend went back in to speak with you as this felt very unfair and unclear. If your house wine only included red wine, that should have been made more obvious. Have attached a picture of your board for reference. Would’ve hoped a resolution could be found when my friend spoke to you and some understanding; now left feeling disappointed by this experience.

Popped in because I was passing, never have I felt so much like I want to take a nap in a good way in a restaurant. The food was incredible, innovative yet homely and accessible. The cocktails made me feel like I was lounging on a beach in Thailand and the sofa made me feel like the Friends crew would pop in for a chat about our pits and falls. Not only have I made friends for life but food for life.

Lots of love,
Ayla

Had a rare night without kids and decided to try Big Night. It did not disappoint! It was excellent! The drinks and food were so punchy and unusual and yummy. Service and atmosphere were really nice and fun. We loved it. Hope to be back soon. Thank you!

Went here with my friend tonight and we had such a good time! Really thoughtful and well done menu and it was all fresh and flavorful. We tried a few different skewers and they were really delicious. Same with the cocktails and the banana banoffe. The atmosphere was really nice and we loved our sweet and funny waiter!!!! Recommend

places.formatted_address: 322-324 Acton Mews, London E8 4EA, UK
places.name: Planque

reviews.text: Undisputedly beautiful food… in awe of the lobster rice still, and the dessert very much stood out. The alcoholic by the glass list could afford to be a little less old world centric given the forward thinking approach to the menu and the service perhaps could benefit from loosening up a bit as it did feel oddly terse, but overall what’s not to love?

Vibey, nightclub-style dining with beautiful lighting and excellent service.

The food isn’t traditionally French in my though they have a nice French wine list. The dishes are creative, experimental, and high quality with interesting flavors. Portions are small—we ordered six dishes and two desserts for two people.  I wasn't particularly hungry so this worked for us.

If you’re looking for something different, fun, and unique, make a reservation and enjoy!

Nice experience, clean flavours, simple but distinguished; the ingredients used in the kitchen are really good; amazing wine, both bottles and by the glasses; portion are what London is offering at the moment with the costs; don't expect huge portions for what you pay, but some of the best quality , skills and flavour;

Everything about this spot is perfect. All dishes looked stunning, and flavours more than matched the looks. Rice dish was a highlight, along with the salad, and don't miss their desserts! Staff were knowledgeable and chill, decor/vibe is casual elegance.

Celebrated my Dad's birthday with some friends and family. In short it was a fantastic experience, phenomenal food and flavours, service was efficient and very friendly and the atmosphere was just perfect.

places.formatted_address: 230B Dalston Ln, London E8 1LA, UK
places.name: Rao's Bar & Restaurant

reviews.text: Still licking my chops! Delicious food. The Lamb Bhuna was very tasty, albeit spicy. Pilau rice, fluffy and fragrant. Butter naan, a little crispier than I'm used to but tasty nonetheless. The mixed tandoori grill was a sizzling feast of meats and onions. The starter came within 10 minutes, and the main meal about 7 mins after. Very generous portions. The music was loud but set the atmosphere and we didn't have to shout to make ourselves heard. Will definitely return to try other dishes on the menu as we enjoyed every one we ate.

The restaurant is actually really good! The food is full of flavor, with everything cooked just right. Normally, I don’t take a liking to restaurants this easily, but I genuinely enjoyed this one. They offer great Indian options along with drinks, making it a perfect spot for both friends and family to hang out.

Special mention to Shruthi for her excellent service. she not only took great care of us but also recommended food based on our choices, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend this place!

My second time in Rao’s restaurant and never disappointed! From amazing negronis to my absolutely favourite Chicken Liver! Very tasty lamb chops  too . For mains , I asked for recommendation and I had Lamb Rogan Josh Kashmiri with some  rice and garlic nan Service was great, very attentive and friendly .I will be definitely come back !! Thank you guys . Sorry I couldn’t wait to take the picture of the full dishes but seeing them finished is also a good thing!!

We really didn’t know what to expect but we were pleasantly surprised by how good and delicious the curry was. It was so flavoursome and great portions. We had the lamb bhuna and the murgh makhani. And honestly the lamb meat was succulent and the sauce of the murgh makhani was unreal. Our waiter Nithin was so lovely and kind, nothing was too much trouble and the service was great. Nice outdoor seating area for evening food and drinks. We both said we’d happily come back to try more of the dishes. Good quality curry.

I had an amazing experience at Rao’s Bar & Restaurant !The ambiance was warm and inviting, with vibrant decor that set the perfect mood. The menu offered a fantastic variety of authentic Indian dishes, and I was blown away by the flavors in their butter chicken and paneer tikka—rich, perfectly spiced, and cooked to perfection. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. Prices were reasonable for the quality, and the portions were generous. Highly recommend this gem for anyone craving delicious Indian cuisine! I’ll definitely be back!

editorial_summary.overview: Hip, leafy market with communal seats serving pizza, deli & veggie cuisine plus a beer garden.

places.formatted_address: 117 Mare St, London E8 4RU, UK
places.name: Mare Street Market

reviews.text:
This place is so lovely, the food was delicious and the staff are great. We were served by Stephanie who was so attentive!
We all shared a few plates and especially loved the padron peppers and arancini. The flavour of the cauliflower wings was yum too!
The desserts are huge so I recommend sharing them!

Great brunch options with delicious food! They also have a healthy menu and fresh juice choices. The seating is fantastic—I sat outside in the sunshine, which added to the amazing ambience and good vibes. Overall, I highly recommend it. After brunch, I even cycled to Columbia Market. The location is excellent too!

Such a nice lunch spot!! Went with my turn friends and were served by Ella who was great! The daiquiris were nice and strong and the food tasted amazing and very filling- it wasn’t too busy either but it was midday on a Friday! genuinely great place and we’re definitely going back

Visiting from America! My buddy told me that I should really super definitely come get the Sunday roast. And I was skeptical! I’ve never had a classic British Sunday Roast™️.

But: delicious and wonderful. Great service - thank you Lewis! -  and a great hot pink daiquiri. And just a good vibe, y’know? People were happy. Children cavorting on Sunday afternoon. Friends having a beer and a talk. Like, what else could I ask for as a person?

Strong recommend. Come on a Sunday!

Had lunch here before catching the train - sat outside as it was very hot. Nice seats in the shade - busy place with good atmosphere and friendly helpful service from the staff. We had an all day breakfast, poached eggs on toast and a beef pizza and a few drinks - all very  good. Sadly my first choice of French toast was off the menu and the very expensive espresso martini was far too sweet and tasted ready made (out a bottle or tap?) so star off for that, but otherwise we loved this place and would go back.

places.formatted_address: 10 Broadway Market Mews, London E8 4TS, UK
places.name: Koya Japanese Restaurant Hackney

reviews.text: We visited this restaurant for late lunch. Maybe we expected to much. Every food was good (like diet version) but nothing impresive. Wakame was served plain, asparagus without any spices..we were missing some extra taste🙃they have only one GF meal- it was nice and yummy.

ambience and authenticity, super awesome japanese spot with soothy katsu curry w pickle and perfectly crisp karaage, and the ko udon was unexpectedly spicy but still fresh and delicious, had lemonade and the seasonal tea was fizzy cold and refreshing

If this place was 15-20% cheaper, it would be a dream. In fact I’d be here twice a month. The vegan donburi was absolutely fine, tasty, plenty of rice. Nothing special at all. No garnish really. Nothing beyond the obvious.

For £19 I had half a beer, rice and 3 bits of courgette with some tofu. It’s my fault for being on Broadway Market, but there are some reasonably priced outlets.

It’s self service with a touchscreen so it feels particularly dissonant in this pricey derelicte surround. Last time I ordered with one of those was McDonald’s.

The problem partly is the old vegan gouge, charging me same price for about 40p of ingredients. It’s not on really. And it was mostly empty on this Monday eve, when for say £12 instead of £16, they’d probably have the place rammed on a weeknight. Shame.

These homemade Udons! ❤️ The cold meaty xo udon is one of the best dishes I've ever eaten! Very authentic Japanese place, with the service and overwhelmingness of choices to match. Donburi is amazing as well.

Nice place but wasn’t blown away! Got the classic udon noodles with prawn tempura. It tasted so plain but I loved how big the tempura was! A dipping sauce is really needed. My partner got the spicy udon with fried fish - a lot more flavourful 😊
For sides we got a salad which was so average and the chicken karage, the crispy parts were very good but some parts weren’t. Overall I’m glad I tried and the vibes are nice! Probably wouldn’t go back again as there’s more udon places out there to try :) thank you!

places.formatted_address: Canary Wharf, London E14 5AJ, UK
places.name: The Alchemist Canary Wharf

reviews.text:
I recently visited The Alchemist, and I must say, the experience was amazing from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious – full of flavour, well-presented, and served fresh. Every bite was a treat!

The drinks were just as impressive. The cocktails were not only creative and visually stunning, but also tasted incredible. You can really tell they put effort into both the taste and the showmanship.

The atmosphere was vibrant and stylish, making it a perfect spot for a chilled night out or a special occasion. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything ran smoothly.

I’ll definitely be going back again soon. Highly recommend for anyone who loves great food, standout drinks, and a unique dining experience!

We had dinner here today and everything was simply outstanding. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. The food was exceptional each dish, from the starters to the main course and drinks, was delicious and beautifully presented. The flavours were spot-on and the portions were generous.

But what truly made our evening unforgettable was the service. A special thank you to Shannon, who went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and well looked after. She was incredibly kind, polite, and attentive throughout the entire meal. Her friendly nature and professionalism stood out, and she’s honestly the number one reason we’re already planning our next visit.

The ambience was lovely and relaxing, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality we received definitely worth every penny.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food, excellent service, and a genuinely pleasant dining experience!

🍸 Chic cocktails with a view

Came here for drinks with a friend — such a great spot for a relaxed girls’ night out! We only ordered two small plates (calamari and prawn lollipops), which were nicely presented and decent in taste, but the highlight was definitely the drinks and atmosphere.

Loved the creative cocktail menu and theatrical presentation — very Instagram-friendly. The riverside outdoor seating made it even better. Service was friendly and the vibe overall was casual and fun. Would come back for drinks and a catch-up anytime!

Fantastic cocktail selection — each drink is both delicious and presented with impressive flair. The coffee is top-notch as well. A pleasant atmosphere and attentive staff make this spot perfect for relaxing and catching up with friends.
I’d heard good things about this place and it didn’t disappoint. Cocktails were quirky and delicious. The atmosphere was very relaxed in the outdoor seating area. Would highly recommended a visit.

places.formatted_address: Crossrail Pl, London E14 5AR, UK
places.name: Big Easy Bar.B.Q & Crabshack - Canary Wharf

reviews.text:
The food was amazing, we got the BBQ Blow out for 2. So much food, amazing flavour & super filling.
The service was also amazing, unfortunately I don’t know our servers name but he was fantastic, so friendly & came over at all the right times, he also brought us a bag for left overs without us even having to ask. We even got a complimentary ice cream. I also liked that you could scan a QR code and pay for your bill via this, rather than having to wait to ask for the bill & then wait for it to be brought to you. This is the 3rd big easy venue I’ve been to, and it is by far the best one.

Loved the vibes and the views. Great quality tasty food. Have been here twice now. The express lunch menu for £11 including a drink is incredible value. Ordering from the main menu gives you choice but is expensive at approx £30 each without sides like chips or a drink and portions aren't very big for the price. But it was a lovely treat and I really enjoyed it here. Would definitely go again and recommend it too.

I’ve been to this restaurant many times, and every visit is a delight. The place is cozy with a beautiful view — especially in the evening when the lights come on and live music begins to play. This time I had the lobster, and it was absolutely perfect — juicy and full of flavor. The drinks were also great — well-balanced and beautifully served.
The staff are always polite, friendly, and make you feel truly welcome. What I really love is that it’s not just about the food — the whole atmosphere helps you relax and enjoy your time. The live music adds a special touch without being too loud or overwhelming.
If you’re looking for a place to unwind and enjoy both great food and ambiance, I highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely keep coming back!

We had a great experience at Big Easy Canary Wharf. Service was excellent – we were seated quickly and our server was friendly and attentive. The live music added a fun atmosphere, and there’s a really good selection of food to choose from.

The food itself was great quality and reasonably priced for the portion sizes. And the milkshakes are honestly to die for – definitely worth trying!

Overall, a lively spot with good food, great service, and a buzzing vibe. Highly recommend and will Be back again!

The staff was welcoming and the service was good. We have order lobster and Taste-O-Rama to share between 2 people and it was a lot of food. The chicken was a bit dry for our taste but the rest was very good (we really enjoyed sausages, lobster and ribs). Atmosphere was great too.

editorial_summary.overview: Industrial chic decor, an upbeat vibe & eclectic global cooking served all day in a hip hub.

places.formatted_address: Reuters Plaza, London E14 5AJ, UK
places.name: Caravan Canary Wharf Restaurant

reviews.text: Our server was attentive and helpful. The restaurant has an everyday elegance type of vibe. Uptempo music playing at the right volume. The beans were just not right. Plain baked beans would have been just fine.

We visited Caravan in Canary Wharf and had a lovely experience! The pizza was fresh and flavourful with a perfectly crispy base – simple but delicious. The real star for us, though, was the spiced cauliflower – beautifully seasoned, warm, and comforting with just the right kick of spice.

The atmosphere was vibrant yet relaxed, with a stylish interior and friendly staff. It’s a great spot whether you’re catching up with friends or looking for a cosy dinner in the city.

Would definitely come back to try more of the menu. 🌿🍕✨

Absolutely phenomenal! From the moment we stepped into the restaurant, we were greeted with warm smiles and a genuinely welcoming atmosphere that immediately set the tone for an unforgettable dining experience.

Let’s talk food — the pizza was nothing short of brilliant. Perfectly blistered crust, rich tomato sauce, and toppings that tasted like they were handpicked in an Italian countryside that morning. Every bite was a little celebration. You can tell the chefs take serious pride in their craft.

And the tiramisu? Divine. Creamy, delicate, with just the right balance of espresso and sweetness — it was the kind of dessert that makes you close your eyes for a second and just savor. Easily one of the best I’ve had anywhere.

But what truly elevated the whole experience was the staff. Attentive without being intrusive, genuinely passionate about the menu, and full of great recommendations. They made us feel like regulars, even though it was our first visit.

This is one of those rare places where everything just clicks. We left already planning our next visit. Highly, highly recommended!

I’ve been to the branch in the city so thought this would be of the same calibre, it was not.
Had the avocado and crispy chickpeas on toast, knew it would be stone cold when I couldn’t force the knife through the toast. But the chickpeas were crispy which thankfully offset the slightly oily avocado.
My daughter had the fruit with yogurt. Took her a while to find the yogurt as she didn’t have a magnifying glass to hand. The quantity and quality  of fruit was marginally better. This was ridiculously overpriced at £12.
The staff were very nice and the setting is lovely but I would not come back here again.

James and I grabbed breakfast at Caravan Canary Wharf this morning. The space itself is really nice, open, bright and a calm pocket in the middle of Canary Wharf.

The coffee was spot on, and the menu has loads of choice without feeling overwhelming. We both had breakfast dishes that were fresh and well put together, with good portions too.

It was busy but not in a bad way, more of a lively atmosphere, and the staff kept things moving without making it feel rushed. Our waitress Lilly was brilliant, really friendly and attentive, which made the experience even better.

Overall, it is a solid spot if you are looking for somewhere reliable for breakfast or a coffee meeting in Canary Wharf.

places.formatted_address: 40 Bank St, London E14 5NR, UK
places.name: Oysteria

reviews.text:
The restaurant is decent with a cozy and chill vibe. The staffs are amazing and passionate. We ordered oyster - the signature dish, a must-order item, really nice and freshy. Other food like the crab linguine and squid ink risotto are perfect as well.

I asked them do me a favor for adding a bday sign on the dessert cake. Super nice chocolate words and bday song music. The staff Shakh is pretty nice and helpful on it. Love the dessert! Wonderful night in Oysteria.

Shakh was taking care of us splendidly. It was our 30th Anniversary and the food was superb. Starters, mains, dessert and dessert wine (shot). The restaurant was also light and airy and clean. But the best were the staff. I would certainly recommend it. 100%!

Food is delicious 😋 Loved the atmosphere. Came here to have some food for mom’s birthday. 2 waiters who served us were brilliant 😄We had so much fun. Really good service 👍 Thank you for lemon water for my mom when she felt unwell 🫶

The atmosphere in Canary Wharf was really nice, and the restaurant had a pleasant setting that we enjoyed. Unfortunately, the food and service didn’t match the environment. My wife’s meal wasn’t properly cooked, which was disappointing, and the service felt mediocre, not terrible, but not very attentive either. Overall, the location and atmosphere were great, but the food and service need improvement for me to consider going back.

I had such a great time dining here Oysteria at Canary Wharf! The food was absolutely delicious. I had the crab linguine and a pineapple drink, and both were perfect. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

The service really stood out too. Shakh, our main waiter, was super attentive and friendly. The rest of the team, Siam and Java, were also really nice and made the whole experience feel welcoming. A special shoutout to Adnan, the bartender he was amazing and made a fantastic drink!

Overall, it was a lovely experience from start to finish. Great food, great atmosphere, and even better people. Highly recommend!

places.formatted_address: 25 North Colonnade, Market Halls, London E14 5HD, UK
places.name: Eggslut Canary Wharf

reviews.text:
First time having Eggslut and it’s so delicious?! We tried the portobello truffle and hash browns. The buns were super soft and airy and the filling was so yummy and tasteful 🤤 Plus the hash browns were super crispy as well 👌 Will definitely keep trying it when we get the chance 🙂‍↕️

The Market Halls was also a peaceful place to sit and relax 💯

We had the sausage, egg & cheese sandwich and bacon, egg & cheese sandwich. Both were delicious. The truffle hash browns were hot and crispy. Prices are a bit on the high side but quality is good. Plenty of seating inside with a coffee bar and bagel bar nearby. Service was friendly and speedy.

Stopped by Eggslut in Canary Wharf this morning after seeing the name and some pics online – and wow, it was amazing. Hands down the best breakfast sandwich we’ve had in ages. Super flavorful and just hit the spot.

The hashbrowns (got mine without truffle) were crispy and perfectly fried. Staff were friendly and on it. Honestly, everything just worked. Already thinking about when we can go back.

The food was bomb. Im on vacation in london and ordered the same thing 3 times. I love there chicken egg sandwich and the basic turkey egg and cheese. Amit and his coworkers were awesome!! Highly recommend to everyone for there trip to london and everyday.

The ‘Fairfax’ sandwhich is incredible, a beautiful blend of flavours. I love the soft warm brioche bun too. Lovely service, lovely atmosphere! I urge you to try the fair fax sandwhich because wow it’s incredible! Beautifully scrambled egg too, just 10/10!

editorial_summary.overview: Mexican restaurant with a lively soundtrack for small plates of market-style food & cocktails.

places.formatted_address: 40 Canada Square, London E14 5FW, UK
places.name: Wahaca Canary Wharf

reviews.text: I recently had dinner at Wahaca and it was amazing! We started with the guacamole and hummus. The guacamole was okay, a little bland, but the hummus was absolutely delicious. For our mains, we ordered the sweet potato...something (I can't remember the name!), buttermilk chicken tacos, and beef tacos. Everything was so flavorful and tasty. We also got the chorizo quesadillas which were beautiful. To finish, we shared the tiramisu for dessert, which was lovely. The service was great, our waiter was really helpful, and the atmosphere was cool. I'd definitely recommend Wahaca to anyone looking for a delicious and fun dining experience

Overall food is acceptable , except for the churros it was a bit too oily and not enough cinnamon sugar on it. The sweet potatoes side dish was pretty good. Tacos are not bad. Service wise is a mix feeling, as either they are in rush and just put all orders on the table at the same time or when you order extra dishes the service is super slow……….

Excellent. Superb tacos. The chicken and avacado was surprisingly good - I’d even say the best. Nice specials with the sweet potato and the spicy Margarita was really good too. Nice vibe and place as well. Mega bonus - Cocktails were

Our waiter, Tyler, was fantastic! He was attentive the entire time and had a great sense of humor that made our evening even better. We were stuffed by the end, but he was already ready with the dessert menu the moment we finished eating—so thoughtful and on the ball. We didn’t have room for dessert, but we definitely appreciated his perfect timing. Thanks, Tyler, for making our dinner such a fun experience!

One of the best Wahaca experiences. The food was just outstanding. Tastes delicious and so fresh. Presentation was great too. The service was impeccable. Such polite staff and so attentive. Didn’t have to look around to find anyone at any point. Simple things like water always being topped up was executed perfectly. 5* service in a chain restaurant is rare. Our server Sasha was the perfect server, outstanding service. The manager Milan was also extremely polite and helpful. Very impressed.

places.formatted_address: Unit RS, 140 15 Cabot Sq, London E14 4QT, UK
places.name: Yolk

reviews.text: No seating, quick ordering via self service screen, amazing healthy sandwich salad and hot food options also general cafe drinks coffee and matcha. Food prepared quickly, had steak Benedict which was amazing, would try other dishes again

This is the most revolting food I have ever been presented with in my life. An “egg box” with two “poached eggs” comes as a soup of raw egg and hollandaise and cooked spinach. So gross why are you serving raw eggs?? At least give it a try to cook them. Horrible

I was the only customer on a Friday morning. 3 of the 5 digital order machines weren’t working. I ordered a smoked salmon and cream cheese bap and it was atrocious. There was a few dabs of cream cheese, some rocket and what looked like leftover salmon. Not to mention the bap was cold and tasted half baked. Absolutely disgusting for £5. If this is the quality you deem satisfactory, I hope to see you out of business soon.

During my recent visit to this Yolk branch, I ordered my drink ahead of time, but it took over five minutes to receive it, even though there were no other customers waiting. I appreciate the variety of food and drink options available to takeaway. I particularly enjoy the cherry matcha with oat milk, and I believe a quicker service would enhance the overall experience.

The shop looks great and is well maintained, the ingredients are good quality as well, but
the sandwich I had was awful. There was barely any chicken and too much sauce/tomatoes. The ratio of bread to meat to salad was completely off tbh and I would highly recommend trying somewhere else as there are several other options.

places.formatted_address: 371 Mile End Rd, Bow, London E3 4QS, UK
places.name: Smoke End Steakhouse

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic dining experience at Smoke End Steakhouse. The Argentine sirloin steak was cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and full of rich flavor. It was easily one of the best steaks I’ve had in a long time. To finish, I tried the tiramisu for dessert, which was light, creamy, and absolutely delicious.

The service was just as memorable as the food. Kamal, the owner, was incredibly warm and accommodating, making us feel truly welcome. The staff were attentive, friendly, and went out of their way to ensure everything was perfect.

Overall, Smoke End Steakhouse is a real gem—wonderful food, a welcoming atmosphere, and outstanding hospitality. Will definitely be seeing me again!

The food here is insanely good!! Every bite was full of flavor and so worth it. The service and atmosphere are both really welcoming and professional — you feel comfortable the moment you walk in. A special shoutout to Kamal, who greeted us with such warmth and looked after us so well. Definitely recommend!

First visit and thoroughly impressed.
The service was attentive, the atmosphere welcoming, and the overall experience very well put together. Staff were hospitable throughout, and the food was of a high standard.

We ordered a selection of dishes: duck taco, calamari, steak, chicken sauté, seared salmon, and the Wagyu burger,  all well-prepared and nicely presented.

Drinks were also excellent, with the bartender’s special, Oreo milkshake, mango drink, pink paradise, and passion fruit mojito offering a good variety for different tastes.

Would definitely recommend for both casual dining and special occasions. A great place to book for family gatherings or group events.

Had dinner at Smoke End Steakhouse today and it was absolutely fantastic! The steak was one of the best I’ve had in London – perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The service was excellent, attentive without being intrusive, and the overall experience felt really special. Prices are also very reasonable considering the quality. Most importantly, it’s Halal, which makes it even better. Highly recommend this place for couples or friends looking for a great dining spot!

The food was absolutely delicious! The steak was cooked to perfection-tender, juicy, and full of flavour. The lamb chops were just as impressive, perfectly seasoned and expertly prepared. What truly elevated the experience, though, was the service. It was nothing short of impeccable attentive, friendly, and professional from start to finish. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience!

places.formatted_address: 455 Wick Ln, Fish Island, London E3 2TB, UK
places.name: Darling's Eatery

reviews.text:
Took my boyfriend for a celebration yesterday and we really love this little hidden gem on Fish Island!

Loved the food, the atmosphere and how quick the service was! Will definitely come back another time.

I recently enjoyed the most gorgeous dining experience at Darlings, over a long lunch with friends. Every detail was carefully thought about, and the food and drinks flowed throughout which is credit to the incredible service and staff. Stand out dishes  included the tuna melon starter, focaccia, the anchovy pasta and of course the tiramisu!! Most importantly, don’t skip the amaro at the end, it’s the perfect pairing with desert. So looking forward to my next visit already!

Darlings is an absolute must. A true hidden gem in Hackney. Charming little restaurant with gorgeous interiors, very relaxed and chic vibe. Service was incredibly attentive and didn’t skip a beat.The food was perfect. Best focaccia I’ve had in a long time. Don’t miss the tuna melon dish. The truffle burrata and the sausage leek and fennel mafaldine was heaven, finished with the tiramisu with their house amaro. This spot is so fab for any occasion. Looking forward to coming again!

Had the most amazing night at Darlings! The food is 10/10, fresh flavours and ingredients and beautiful presentation! The restaurant is warm and aesthetic and the perfect place for a date night or to catch up with a group of friends. The pasta was some of the best I’ve had ever and tiramisu is a game changer. The staff are lovely, you have to go and try it yourself!

A lovely restaurant hidden somewhere in Hackney Wick. The atmosphere is good, staff are friendly, but the pasta were not 100% our type, a bit too dry, taste of sauce could be better and more. The truffle burrata is amazingly delicious. Good spot for local to chill.

places.formatted_address: 387 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5QR, UK
places.name: The Bourbon

reviews.text: Great place to come and drink bourbon (obviously). We came on a Friday night after dinner. The place was busy but there were a couple of tables free. We asked the barman for bourbon recommendations and his recs were great. He was very knowledgeable on the different bourbons and could explain what made them special. They have a good looking cocktail menu too. We will definitely come back!
£20 for burger, fries, 4 wings and a pint - great value for tasty food. Barman very friendly and welcoming. Would definitely go back, some of the best value in the area.

Stopped off here for drinks with friends and it was a delightful experience: great cocktails, an owner who's hugely knowledgeable about everything he stocks and a superb atmosphere. Highly recommend, will definitely return if I'm in the area again.

I have been a frequent customer in the past 5 years. Dominic the bartender is extraordinarily professional and good at chatting. Good selection of the bourbon, wonderful live music on Saturdays and decent food (I prefer the smokehouse though).
The location is not quite ideal. But it is a good American bar for residents in Hackney and Tower Hamlets.

places.formatted_address: 116 Bow Rd, Bow, London E3 3AA, UK
places.name: Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells

html_attributions: Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells

reviews.text: This place was such a pleasant surprise.  We went on a Friday night and found out really quickly that it was a hosting a karaoke night by the hostess with the biggest funniest personality.  As an American couple just visiting the area all the locals were awesome and friendly.  This was definitely like any of the stuff bars.  So many patrons from other tables were friendly and chatty with us and made us feel like we were a local.  The bartenders were nice and the food was very good.  We recommend the birria tacos and the fish tacos.  They both were very flavorful.  This was a great pub.  Beer on tap was average price and cold and yummy.  Karaoke night was soo fun and everyone sang along.  Highly recommend this place.

1 word…AMAZING!

Was really craving some birria tacos yesterday, and this place looked unreal. First thoughts wasn’t expecting a pub, but the vibes were nice. We ordered the fish tacos, birria tacos (duh), Jalapeño bites, loaded nachos & quesadillas.

Now let’s break it down:
1. quesadillas - Nothing crazy just plain cheese quesadillas, however you can add birria meat to it which i would be keen to try next time.
2. Jalapeño bites - So good, they were super creamy, would maybe like a bit more jalapeño but delicious either way
3. Loaded nachos - Incredible! they also add a layer of their sauce in between the nachos so you are NOT left with dry flavorless nachos at the end. Which not many places do that.
4. Fish tacos - Unreal, never actually had fish tacos before but these did not disappoint, burst of flavour in each bite. Will be getting again.
5. Birria tacos - and finally the birria tacos. I have had this craving for possibly over 6 months, but no place looked good until i found this one and boy was it good. The meat was so juicy, so tender not too chewy. Really set the standard for birria tacos, I am obsessed.

In terms of atmosphere, the staff seemed so lovely, music was playing, they even had some board games which we ended up playing some trivia with. Was a lot of fun!

Lucky for me, this place is only 1 stop away from me, so i will most definitely be back over and over again. If you come across this area, you MUST give it a try. It will not disappoint :)

You might be put off by the bar it's located in; I was when I first stepped in - it's dated, a little tired and could do with a bit of loving (but then again I guess we all are).

But the welcome from the bartender was so warm and you immediately feel like this place has been your local for years.

The menu is simple - which I like - and we ordered (almost) everything on it.

The taste was absolutely incredible. Wow.

Their portions are huge, fresh, and delicious; and their prices are refreshing for London.

Their fish tacos were my favourite.

10/10
Very full bellies without feeling like I had just been mugged.
Very decent Mexican food considering the location! The birria tacos were pretty good & the churros were excellent. Well worth it on a Tuesday for taco tuesday

Best Birria Tacos in London!
Totopos with guacamole are fresh and tasty.
Always come back for the cosy pub atmosphere and great food😊
P.S Finish off with churros

places.formatted_address: 554 Mile End Rd, Bow, London E3 4PL, UK
places.name: Momlette

reviews.text:
British-Bengali fusion café, very unique. Stays true to the classic British-style breakfast diner yet characteristically Indian-inspired both in dishes and in vibe.

What I liked most about this place was the atmosphere and how it welcomes people of all backgrounds; there's something for everyone on the menu to enjoy.

Huge cafe, compared to the one in Brick Lane. Very clean loo. Food was not bad (we tried the Half English). Unfortunately we couldn’t eat the French Toast as it was very burnt. Fair enough they were kind to not charge us for that. Lady staff from Ukraine was very helpful and friendly.

Try Bengali brunch at Momlette, a cosy café just off Brick Lane. They serve English breakfast with masala beans alongside all-day plates like Deshi half roast chicken. I ordered the Vegan Momlette,  a chickpea omelette with vegan feta, spinach and mushrooms wrapped in vegan paratha, finished with truffle oil and served with fresh spinach, grilled mushroom and tomato. It was delicious, filling and a really unique brunch option in East London. A great spot if you’re looking for vegan brunch or something different in Shoreditch. The space is small and cosy. Service was friendly.

Wow!! This takes comfort food to a new level. The scrambled eggs are unmatched to any other brunch spot I've tried. REALLY authentic bengali flavours which leaves you full and grateful. Sausages were spicy and well seasoned, all around this dish has the small tweaks to a full english that makes it a game changer. Staff were welcoming and quick. Thoughtful and symbolic decorations - loved the carrom board tables!! Will definitely come back :)

Mass produced half English breakfast.
Disappointing. Everything on my plate was half warm when I received my order.
Have had better brunch and English breakfast. Okay to visit for hot drinks not for full breakfast.

places.formatted_address: 90, 92 Bow Rd, Bow, London E3 3AA, UK
places.name: Grounded London

reviews.text: Grounded Bow is one of the best brunch spots I’ve visited in East London.
