What I have always appreciated were the mezes offered for the clients while waiting for their food.
Once again, our favourite Turkish restaurant.

The food was okay overall — nothing exceptional but decent enough. We ordered a platter to share between 2-3 people, which was a good portion. The complimentary bread was a nice touch and tasted fresh. One thing to note: hummus is not included with the platter, which felt a bit disappointing, and we had to pay £4 extra for it. On a positive note, the fresh juice was excellent — refreshing and full of flavour. Overall, it was a good experience, though a few small improvements could make it even better.

We were the only customers. The restaurant was empty so we had the best service we could expect. Rodrigo (manager) was super helpful and made us feel very comfortable. My lamb Shish was superb. Excellent quality and cooked to perfection. My wife’s lamb Sarma Beyti wasn’t amazing but just acceptable aah, and her fries(chips) were frozen… We enjoyed the experience and we’ll come back to try other menu options. The restaurant is beautiful and looked great.
Added extra pics from times I went again after this review.

places.formatted_address: 579 - 581 Cranbrook Rd, Gants Hill, Ilford IG2 6JZ, UK
places.name: Yokoso Restaurant - Japanese & Italian Cuisine

reviews.text:
At first I was confused about the fusion of cuisines but I shouldn’t have judged a book by its cover because the food was fantastic.

My favourite was the beef ramen and the wood fired pizzas.

The sushi and sashimi admittedly could have had more finesse but I won’t hold that against them because it tasted great.

The fried chicken bites were crispy and packed with flavour, and the accompanying spicy mayo was delicious.

Even the tap water was tasty with the addition of cucumber and lemon.

The kids also loved to see the fish in the centre of the restaurant.

Intrigued by the sign, "Authentic Japanese and Italian Restaurant," my family and I ventured into this lovely restaurant. The place looks great, clean and tidy, with an open kitchen and well-dressed chefs. Every time you make eye contact with them, they smile or ask if you need anything. The restaurant manager greeted us; she was very professional and kind, making us feel at ease right away and was attentive and attentive throughout the service. Despite being Italian, I haven't tried the Italian cuisine; I try that every day at home, so I didn't try any dishes. Obviously, I came in for the Japanese. As with almost all Japanese restaurants, we're talking about Euro-Japanese dishes, quite well-made and reasonably priced. The flavors are good, and I even found a few welcome specials. Overall, I had a good experience. I recommend it.

Yokoso offers incredibly fresh and delicious Italian and Japanese dishes—both are equally impressive. The flavors were amazing, and the service was outstanding. Roberta was a fantastic waitress—friendly, attentive, and professional. A truly enjoyable dining experience. Highly recommended!

The sushi was amazing and very authentic. All the dishes we ordered tasted delicious. The staff were all friendly and attentive and they even made us a special mango drink which was very yummy.  He even helped us take some very good photos, attached to the review :) The restaurant decor is modern and everything was very clean. Highly recommend and will definitely be returning! Thank you!

The vibe was really nice, the food was also really good we ordered from the Japanese menu and it was all really nice, especially the noodles and the cooked sushi. The staff recommended an off the menu special mango drink that was really good. Overall service was really good and they even gave us a complimentary dessert at the end. Would definitely come back again.

places.formatted_address: 402 Cranbrook Rd, Gants Hill, Ilford IG2 6HW, UK
places.name: Salamis Restaurant

reviews.text: Ordered the wings and chips from JustEat and was expecting the food to be the grilled wings as shown in the picture. Ended up getting this pathetic box of chicken nuggets and chips. Called the restaurant only to talk to an incompetent staff member who kept blaming me for ordering wrong, when clearly they falsely advertised and then pretended as if it's not their fault. Poor service, poor management, never ordering again and this was supposed to be a first. Would never recommend this place to any sane person.
The food here is very good for the price. Tasty and freshly cooked. Give it a try. Service was good.

Absolute rip-off. They charge £12 for a doner wrap with barely any meat, just loads of salad. Even sauce costs £1, and they charge extra if you ask for more. Right in front of them, Wahad sells the same wrap for £7 with better quality. This place is a joke—terrible service, overpriced food, and a complete waste of money. Never again.

Nice evening meal with the family. Great portion size, not lacking in flavour and a nice spacious eating area. Friendly, attentive staff. Chefs cooking live in an open kitchen, but the eating area is well ventilated and therefore smoke from the kitchen isn’t overwhelming. Seating area outdoors too, for when the weather is nice.
I really recommend best Halal food turkish and fast food mix recommended ❤️👍👍

places.formatted_address: Unit 11, Redbridge Enterprise Centre, Thompson Cl, Ilford IG1 1TY, UK
places.name: Shezan GCD

reviews.text: Been ordering from here quite often, love the variety of food they have especially the bun kebabs and peri chicken and rice overall amazing service and it's kid friendly too. Can't wait to try their other options

Authentic, homecooked Pakistani food. Really delicious.
I ordered 2 dishes. I'm confident that they are all good. Will order again for sure.
We ordered briyani and it was very nice and totally different to all other briyani places worth trying it price and the food is good

Peri peri chicken was delectable, flavoursome and mouthwatering.
Alhumdulilah will be able to have delicious grill chicken 🐔 in Chelmsford which no one has done yet.
Just ordered from Shezan GCD and it did not disappoint. Food was amazing & full of flavour, would definitely recommend

places.formatted_address: 17a Cranbrook Rd, Ilford IG1 4DU, UK
places.name: Crave Station

reviews.text: I been there several times with family and we always prefer to take PERI PERI family bucket. The price is very much affordable and the HOT flavor is too good to taste. We were served by AHMED , an ever smiley guy who took good care of us. We got the food within 10 minutes and the food like peri peri chicken and fries were Smokey and fresh. The atmosphere was too good to chat and eat with family. I will always recommend everyone to have their meal with family.

After checking the reviews I visited Crave Station Ilford, the burger was good but the chicken wings were not too satisfying, but over all enjoyed, I heard its famous for its pizzas, definitely gonna try next, and will update....

I had a great experience at Crave Station! The food was delicious, prices were fair, and the customer service was outstanding. Special thanks to Ahmed and  Yaku  for being so kind and helpful — they really made the visit enjoyable. I’ll definitely come again. Highly recommended!

— Omar

Quality food with quite good ambiance . Staff was well mannered and take my order very carefully because i have some food allergic .
Pizza stuff is pretty good.

Had a great experience at  CRAVE STATION! From the moment we walked in, the service was excellent. All the staff was so friendly and helpful, really made me feel at home. The food was also really good, everything was fresh, hot, and full of flavour. You can tell they take pride in what they do. Overall, a really nice atmosphere and a place l'd happily come back to. Definitely recommend giving it a try!

editorial_summary.overview: Relaxed Turkish, Mediterranean & Persian halal eatery offering grilled dishes & takeaway options.

places.formatted_address: 55, 57 Cranbrook Rd, London IG1 4PG, UK
places.name: Wazir Restaurant

reviews.text: Was lovely having food here. Drinks, food and dessert was lovely! Should do tap water and ice but other than that, great service especially from our waiter,  Dominic.  Very friendly,  bubbly and made us feel very welcomed. As did his colleagues. Food was really good and close to ilford station.
The food is delicious but they are lacking badly on customer service. I would have definitely given 5 stars but they are short of staff, the poor girl was struggling alone to serve us and everybody.

It was my husband's 60 and my kids Hajj get together. We booked for 60 people, we went in the morning to do the decorations. The restaurant allowed us to decorate the hall, and they also put our desserts and cake in the fridge.
Najmeh and Shoaib were amazing. They made sure everything went well. They were very helpful, polite, professional and supportive throughout the event.
The only thing is that the restaurant doesn't give tap water and charges for soft drinks are too much.

Other than that it was a great experience and everyone was really happy with their service.
Thank you
My experience here was very good. The atmosphere was very pleasant, the people were friendly, and the breakfasts were highly recommended. Very tasty. I'm very satisfied. I'll be back again.

Nice Turkish Food went there for Breakfast. Was really nice. Nice atmosphere. Perfect for family and large groups. Very large seating area.

Food is great. I used to get thr Chicken Thighs when theiy 1st opened in Ilford dont know if they still do it but was really good.

places.formatted_address: 545 Cranbrook Rd, Gants Hill, Ilford IG2 6HE, UK
places.name: Smoke & Pepper (Gants Hill)

reviews.text:
Amazing high-quality fast food in Gants Hill!

When I’m craving a smash burger, fries, or fried chicken, Smoke and Pepper is my go-to spot in Gants Hill. The food is top quality and reasonably priced, especially compared to Ghost Burgers nearby.

I got the Chilli Smash Burger, which had a nice kick to it, along with the Dynobites (an absolute must try, think PF Chang’s Dynamite Prawns but with chicken). The fries were solid, and I love that all the sauces are included with no extra charges or nonsense.

Overall, the food is excellent and great value for money. It’s not the cheapest burger around, but the quality definitely justifies the price. The only downside is that it can get very busy on Friday and Saturday nights, and the seating area is a bit cramped. Service could be a little better, but the food more than makes up for it.

Highly recommend, this spot is not to be missed!

I had a great experience at Smoke & Pepper! The chicken tenders and chips were full of amazing flavor, perfectly cooked, and so satisfying. The drinks were just as good and paired really well with the meal. Overall, a delicious and enjoyable experience – I’ll definitely be coming back!

Had an absolutely delicious meal at smoke and pepper. Tried the miso chicken burger and Korean tenders and both were fresh and full of flavour. I have been multiple times and it’s consistently terrific in terms of food quality, cleanliness and service. Amal who served us today did an excellent job managing a busy restaurant and ensured I and other customers were looked after, with our order arriving quickly. Highly recommended.

Ordered from here today for lunch and was not dissapointed.

Their smash burger was amazing. One of the best ive had.

The half chicken was really well cooked. It was flavoursome and good size.

The rice was decent. The coleslaw was pretty good.

I highly recommend trying this place. 10 out of 10.
Staff were attentive when i walked in. I did not have to wait long as the shop was empty.  I got the Algerian chicken strips  which was nice but a little too sweet. Reasonably priced.

places.formatted_address: 62-64 Cranbrook Rd, Cranbrook, Ilford IG1 4NH, UK
places.name: The Urban Chocolatier

reviews.text: Great atmosphere for kids and families. Parking was close by which made it really convenient. We were served by Hamiz Khan, who was absolutely lovely! & very helpful in guiding us with what to order. We tried the cookie dough, milkshake, and lotus milk cake ; all delicious! Definitely recommend visiting if you’re in Ilford and craving a sweet treat.

We stopped by The Urban Chocolatier for dessert after lunch in the local area. The place had plenty of seating and an impressive selection of desserts to choose from.
It was our first time trying the Afterparty Sundae and it didn’t disappoint, rich, indulgent, and absolutely delicious. My girls went for the bubblegum ice cream, which went down a treat with big smiles all round.
Service was good and prompt, making the visit smooth and enjoyable. The only downside was that the floor was a little sticky and could have used a quick mop. Aside from that, I’d definitely recommend it for anyone with a sweet tooth.

This dessert spot is a great place to satisfy your sweet tooth! The strawberry crepes were absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The interior is spacious and comfortable, making it a nice place to relax and enjoy your treat. The only downside is that parking can be a bit difficult, especially during busy times. Still, it's worth the visit for the desserts alone!

I had an excellent experience with Naz! She provided outstanding customer service—friendly, attentive, and very professional. Naz went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of, and I truly appreciated her patience and helpful attitude. Thank you for making the experience so smooth and pleasant!
The waffles are good. It was really yummy. The service by Naz was very excellent and she was very professional with her way of approach. Overall the service and atmosphere was top notch.

places.formatted_address: 815 High Rd, Ilford IG3 8TD, UK
places.name: Zu's Ilford

reviews.text:
I have been eating in Zu’s on and off for over 15 years.  They always make the same great Chicken Grill, it’s superb, grilled from raw (not boiled first like everyone else).  Takes longer but you get a proper grill taste.  Always the same standard and great taste.

The staff always try to please customers too.

Review for Zu’s, High Road Seven Kings (Uber Eats Order #8808F, placed around 3:00 AM on 18 April 2025)

I had a very bad and dangerous experience ordering from this restaurant. I found a staple pin inside a piece of meat in my food. While chewing, I felt something sharp in my mouth—it turned out to be a metal staple embedded in the meat.

Thankfully, I didn’t swallow it or suffer any injury, but this could have caused serious harm if it had gone unnoticed. It’s extremely concerning that something like this could make it into a customer’s meal.

This kind of negligence is completely unacceptable. I have taken clear photos of the staple and the food for documentation and will be reporting this to Uber Eats and the relevant food safety authorities.

I strongly advise the restaurant to urgently inspect their kitchen practices and ensure this never happens again. What happened was not just careless—it could have been dangerous to someone’s health.

Overall the food is really tasty and fresh, especially the chicken grill. The chicken was tender and juicy. The naans are made infront of you. The sitting area is small and the toilet is a bit dirty. Also the service is a bit slow as they receive too many delivery orders. But the food is really good. Highly recommended.

Worst food
I had an extremely disappointing experience here. The food smelled & tasted stale, food was cooked several days ago. The vegetables and daals were especially unpleasant.
A friend who previously worked there confirmed they sell food that’s 8–10 days old,microwave displayed food to show its fresh, and even reuse leftover sauces from customers instead of discarding them🤮🤮. This is absolutely unhygienic and unacceptable. 🤢🤮

I strongly advise avoiding this place for your own health and safety.

Always dined at Zu’s in Green street, however ever since I’ve moved further down I’ve been coming to the Ilford branch and the taste and atmosphere is the same. Delicious food all around and they’re open till very late. Freshly cooked and prepared in front of you.

places.formatted_address: 396 Cranbrook Rd, Gants Hill, Ilford IG2 6HW, UK
places.name: Famz Peri Peri

reviews.text:
This pizza is pure fire—crispy crust, gooey cheese, rich sauce, and bold toppings that hit just right. Every bite is packed with flavor and comfort. One slice turns into the whole box before you know it.

The toppings are fresh, bold, and loaded just right, whether you’re into classic pepperoni or something spicy and unique. It’s the kind of pizza that hits all the right spots and keeps you reaching for just one more slice.

The staff is warm, humble, and always ready with a smile, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Famz Peri Peri delivered an exceptional dining experience! The Peri Peri Chicken and Wings were cooked to perfection—juicy, tender, and packed with bold, smoky Peri Peri flavors. The Peri Peri Chips were a standout, perfectly crunchy and generously topped with zesty Peri Peri seasoning. The Mango Crush Drink was refreshing and complemented the meal beautifully. The addition of fresh salads added a nice balance to the dish. Overall, a fantastic meal with great flavors and quality—highly recommend!

The customer service of Komal is truly amazing.
She’s so nice and kind. And handles customers so nicely. She is always very helpful and looking forward to seeing if anything else is needed.
I’m very much satisfied with her service.
Keep it up !! ❤️🫶

Famz is a total winner in my book! The chicken is always cooked to perfection – crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The sides are just as amazing, especially their seasoned fries and creamy coleslaw. What sets Famz apart is the quality of their ingredients; you can really taste the difference. Plus, the staff are always friendly and the service is quick, making it a great spot for a satisfying and convenient meal. If you're craving some seriously good chicken, Famz is the place to go!
The taste and texture of pizza so good and perfectly cooked and delicious.A must visit place in Gants Hill.

places.formatted_address: 72 Ilford Ln, Ilford IG1 2LA, UK
places.name: Taj Grill

reviews.text: The atmosphere is very nice. Nice music being played. They have lots of room downstairs. Service was very quick and friendly staff. We ordered the Tawa Lamb and it was very nice. Lamb chop was abit chewy but overall I would still come back again and would recommend this place.

The samosa chat was not all that nice. The grilled burger was nice, and so was the small mixed grill. Not a lot of people and the service was fast. Restaurant has toilets and plenty of seating with a nice red decor. Decent food, and it cost us about £50 for a family of 5, though it wasn't a place so great I would want to come again

Great Food at Taj Grill!

We recently visited Taj Grill, and overall, it was a good experience. While the service wasn’t extraordinary, the food definitely made up for it. We ordered Fish jhal Fry, which was more of a curry-style dish, and it was absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, and it paired perfectly with the fresh, warm naan.

The food quality was impressive, with everything tasting fresh and well-prepared. The restaurant’s environment was also pleasant, making for a comfortable dining experience.

If you’re looking for tasty food in a nice setting, Taj Grill is definitely worth a visit!

Disappointing Experience – Dishonest Service

I ordered the Mini Platter and Lamb Tikka Masala from Taj Grill, but instead of lamb, they served mutton without informing us. When we questioned them, they blatantly lied about it. This kind of dishonesty is unacceptable, especially when customers expect transparency about what they are eating.

On top of that, the food itself was average at best. The flavors were not as great as expected, and the quality didn’t justify the price. If they can’t be honest about their ingredients, how can customers trust anything else on their menu? Would not recommend.
One of the worst taste on Ilford lane.  Very disappointed.  We ordered Chicken acahari Karachi and it was not properly cooked and load of oil. Never recommend that place to anyone.

places.formatted_address: Upper Level, 2 Cabot Sq, London E14 4QT, UK
places.name: Gallio

reviews.text: Me & my friend had a great experience at GALLIO! We went for the bottomless pizza and it was absolutely delicious. Starters were amazing & the bottomless prosecco was great! The mocktails were refreshing and beautifully presented. The service was very friendly and attentive. Perfect place for a tasty meal with great vibes. Highly recommend & we will come again!

We came here to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival with my best friends, and it turned out to be such a lovely surprise! Everything from the atmosphere to the food felt perfect for a special occasion.
The whole experience felt warm, genuine, and celebratory. Highly recommend this place for special occasions, birthdays, or a cozy dinner with friends. Definitely coming back!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Had such a great time at Gallio! We went for the bottomless pizza brunch and it was honestly amazing — the pizzas just kept coming and every one was so tasty. The cocktails were delicious too (definitely try the spritz!). The vibe was super fun and the staff were lovely, really made the experience. Perfect spot for a weekend catch-up with friends — can’t wait to go again! 🍕🥂

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely loved this place! The Mediterranean main course had a Moroccan twist full of flavour and perfectly cooked. The starters were delicious too, especially the creamy burrata and the truffle one (I’m a huge truffle lover!). The salad was super fresh and refreshing.

The staff were lovely and friendly, and the whole vibe of the restaurant was cosy and welcoming. Definitely one of those hidden gems you’d love to come back to. Highly recommend!

My visit at Gallio was fantastic. From the attentive staff, to the refreshing bubbles and the delicious plates. We had a vegetarian shawarma with 4 sides and everything was so flavourful and fragrant. We especially loved the cheesy flatbread and the fatoush salad. We would definitely come back for another dinner here! 5 stars!

editorial_summary.overview: Handmade, Southern Italian-style pastas and elevated coffee offered in hip, modern-rustic surrounds.

places.formatted_address: 20 Canada Square, London E14 5NN, UK
places.name: Scarpetta

reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised. Probably the best pasta aribratta dish I've ever had. Good cocktail and service. Friends equally enjoyed their pasta dishes. Highly recommended.

I’ve been here twice and  it was over a year apart. The food quality remains so high. From starter to dessert everything I’ve ever ordered has been so insanely tasty. Just need the option of a boat load of Parmesan for those who want it😂 staff was friendly and attentive

Decent Italian Spot with Room for Improvement

We had dinner here on a Wednesday night, and while the experience was overall okay, it felt like something was missing.

The service was fine—servers were friendly and happy to recommend dishes, but we weren’t given water, which is a basic expectation. We ordered three starters (see pictures) and two pasta mains. The pasta was delicious, well-priced, and definitely the highlight of the meal, though the menu had fewer options than expected. Sometimes, less is more, but a bit more variety would have been nice.

The drinks menu was somewhat limited—there was a good wine selection, but only a few beer choices. The restaurant wasn’t very busy, which made for a relaxed atmosphere. However, the space isn’t wheelchair or stroller-friendly due to the steps, which could be a downside for some diners.

One issue was that we were mistakenly charged for an item we didn’t order, though the staff did make up for it by offering a small takeaway tiramisu.

Given its prime location in the heart of Canary Wharf, this place has the potential to be a top Italian dining spot. With a few tweaks—better accessibility, more menu variety, and attention to small service details—it could truly stand out.

We visited the restaurant on August 2nd without a reservation, but Andreea Simona provided excellent service and was kind enough to seat us for 1 hour and 15 minutes, which was more than enough time to enjoy our meal. She never made us feel rushed, and we truly appreciated her warm and professional approach.

The food was of high quality, although the vegetarian options were a bit limited. There were no soups available at the time, but overall, we had a great dining experience.

A special shout-out to the staff for going above and beyond — two days after our visit, I realized I had lost my favorite hat and had a feeling I might have left it behind. Since we were staying nearby, I stopped by the restaurant, and to my surprise, they had found it and kept it safe for me. I was so happy and grateful!

Thank you all for the wonderful experience — both during the meal and afterward!

We ordered the pork belly as a starter, but found it quite average and not really worth the price.

The fresh pasta, though, was delicious! We tried two kinds — the beef shin ragu pappardelle had a nice balance of sauce and pasta, really comforting and well done. The pesto seafood casarecce was okay, but didn’t really surprise us. The flavour was quite one-note and got a bit heavy towards the end.

That said, the service was lovely and the atmosphere was great — very pleasant overall.

editorial_summary.overview: Polished family-run Italian restaurant with a chic cocktail lounge & terrace dining.

places.formatted_address: 4 Pan Peninsula Square, London E14 9HN, UK
places.name: Capeesh

reviews.text: It looks like an Italian restaurant in appearance however when I heard a Turkish song playing one day, I realized that the owner is Turkish. Overall, it’s a nice place to go and enjoy food as well as drinks. I tried many dishes there including chicken and pasta and drinks like wine and signature cocktails. They were all amazing. It’s located in a nice and central place, close to my home. Staff is so kind and nice. The view is amazing, looking through the Isle of Dogs. A bit pricey but it is worth it. Highly recommended!

Beautiful Italian restaurant in Canary Wharf. It was relatively busy on a Saturday night; therefore quite loud with the large groups - buts it’s to be expected I suppose. The location itself is stunning, with street parking available nearby. The restaurant is large, spacious, and beautifully decorated – I absolutely love the colour scheme and overall design.

It’s quite rare to find authentic halal Italian, so this really is a gem, even though I went for vegetarian options. All of food was delicious, fresh ingredients, presented well, excellent quality, and the portions are absolutely huge. Not cheap but definitely worth the money.

The service was excellent, with very attentive and friendly waiters. It’s definitely a place I’d recommend and one I’d happily return to. I might even make it one of my regular spots whenever I’m craving Italian.

I also can’t wait for the weather to warm up again so I can sit outside as I love al fresco dining, and this would be the perfect place for it.

Overall, an excellent restaurant in every way.

An outstanding experience from start to finish at Capeesh
My recent visit to Capeesh Bar and Restaurant in Canary Wharf was absolutely fantastic. Everything, from the moment we arrived to the moment we left, was simply exceptional. It's safe to say that this is one of the best Italian dining experiences you can have in London, and I will definitely be returning.
The atmosphere is a perfect blend of modern elegance and welcoming warmth. The chic decor features contemporary lighting and stylish, comfortable furniture, creating a vibrant yet intimate space. We were a large group of 12 and had a fantastic table, with the restaurant offering plenty of great options for both inside dining and outside on the lovely terrace. It's a versatile space perfect for any occasion.
The food was beyond delicious, with each dish being a standout. The menu offers a great choice for all tastes, and the generous portion sizes mean you certainly won't leave hungry. Our table enjoyed a variety of dishes, and everyone raved about the quality, freshness, and authentic Italian flavours. The restaurant's commitment to using quality ingredients really shines through.
To complement our meal, we took full advantage of the excellent 2-for-1 cocktail offer. The cocktails were perfectly mixed and a delightful addition to an already superb afternoon/evening.
What truly elevated our experience, however, was the impeccable service from our waiter, Kumar. He was outstanding throughout the afternoon, effortlessly looking after our large table of 12 with a positive attitude and without any issues. He was consistently attentive, friendly, and always there when we needed something. The service was a masterclass in hospitality.
For anyone looking for an outstanding meal in a beautiful setting with an exceptional team, look no further. I strongly recommend Capeesh Bar and Restaurant and look forward to my next visit!

As a regular customer, I always loving coming to capeesh. Food is delicious and drinks are very good too. Atmosphere is top notch and service is great. Im not very keen on the pricing of the menu as it is very expensive. 2 people got 2 mains 2 drinks and 1 desert totaling £80+.

CAPIESE Italian Cuisine • Bar & Lounge
Delicious food and beautiful presentation — the ambiance is truly elegant. Unfortunately, the service didn’t match the quality of the kitchen. The waitstaff seemed lazy and inattentive, as if serving guests was a burden. Hopefully, management will address this — the place has great potential.

editorial_summary.overview: Relaxed, classic pub featuring a seasonal menu & Sunday roasts, plus a heated garden.

places.formatted_address: 456 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0EA, UK
places.name: Bethnal Green Tavern

reviews.text:
We love u bethnal green tavernnnn!
Love hanging around here, great selection of drinks and great seating indoors and outdoors. It can get busy at times but can often find a seat.
Finally came for a Sunday Roast and can confirm it’s banging. It wasn’t busy at all which is crazy for how lovely the food is. It’s great pricing too and with extra sides, drinks, desserts it only came to £50pp give or take.
The roasts itself were delicious enough that the extra sides that we got (cauliflower and stuffing) weren’t even necessary since we weren’t blown away by them.
Portions are generous and food is so well done and hearty. Definitely recommend the beef option, but the chicken is also great because the portion is so generous (half bird). The Sticky toffee pudding dessert is to die for. Only qualm would be that service was on the slower side despite it not being busy, but the staff are so lovely here that it wasn’t the biggest issue.
Love it here, you will see me again very soon.

Really nice little pub, the area isn’t great but super close to station. Affordable beer and LOTS of options which I love. The indoor part is round and quite small but honestly that’s fine, and then the outside area is really nice! Large and spacious, with heated tables at the back (and the heaters stay on for long!)

The food was also really nice!! I had the chicken wings and a pickled something Vegetable, delicious!

Always a varied and interesting lineup of beers available, good cocktails and food. Staff are friendly and service is always quick. Probably the best beer garden in the area - it can get very busy but that’s a sign of how popular it is.

me and two friends had been planning a sunday roast outing in london for a while and found a really great spot here! i had the chicken roast, got stuffing extra and my friend got pigs in blankets extra which we all tried. really excellent meat, yorkshire pudding and stuffing, lovely service and sat outside in the sun - what more could you want for a memorable roast experience?

also the pigs in blankets came with mustard, which i'd never had in the context of a roast before, but it worked beautifully!

🚇 Bethnal Green
🍺 £6.40 Camden Pilsner
❤️ The new breed of East End Pub.
.
The Bethnal Green Tavern is located on busy Bethnal Green Road. Bethnal Green tube station is only a few minutes walk down the road.
.
This pub was rebuilt in its current guise in 1864 and used to be a Charrington’s house called The Camden Head. It was taken over by Wetherspoons for some years and called The Misty Moon, in 2020 The Graceland PubCo took over what is today, The Bethnal Green Tavern.
.
This is a large one bar pub with a good size servery at its core. The decor here in main is traditional with lots of copper poser tables and low level seating. The pub is fairly dimly lit as most of the natural light comes in through the front windows, as you head towards the back of the bar it does feel cosy with the candles on the tables. At the rear of the pub is the beer garden with plenty of benches and covered spaces.
.
The beer selection was very impressive with over twenty beers, ales and ciders to go at. After a bit of consultation I decided on a Camden Pilsner, I have never tried this beer before and thoroughly enjoyed it. Price point though was expensive for the area. I was feeling a bit Hank so I decided to check out the food menu. I ordered a Fish Finger sandwich and fries for £12, my food was delicious and a hearty portion.
.
I visited around 4pm on a Saturday and the pub was busy with an upbeat atmosphere. There are two types of pub in Bethnal Green, the staunch local full of punters that have drunk in the same pub man and boy. The other is full of new residents to the area, young professionals and students who are part of East London’s gentrification, this pub is the latter. The service here was excellent, the staff really know their stuff and were very hospitable.
.
The @bethnalgreentavern is a fantastic pub with a superb beer choice and decent tucker. The atmosphere and vibe here is relaxed and chilled, the service is top drawer too. One of the best of the new breed in the area.
.
ℹ️ Info correct on visiting 04.02.23

editorial_summary.overview: Cosy Italian restaurant with framed pictures on the walls, subtle lighting and Neapolitan pizzas.

places.formatted_address: 385 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 9RA, UK
places.name: Italina385

reviews.text:
It's a low key neighnbourhood Italian in Bethnal Green that probably mostly supplies locals with pizzas, but is a surprisingly terrific restaurant.  Not living in the area, we were last here maybe eight years ago, but I still remember the pasta alla vongole I had on that occasion.  We've been to a lot of more expensive, and more famous Italians in London, but this place really reminds me of eating at trattorias on vacation in Italy.  Simple menu, terrific ingredients cooked in a way you can taste the individual components, and everything homemade.  They do serve dried pasta, which I actually prefer because its texture is more chewy.

My companion had the bruschetta to start followed by the burrata served on a bed of  grilled vegatables.  Both of his starters came with a fantastic focaccia which had big airy bubbles toasted to a crisp.  There was a tiny drizzle of pesto on the burrata that looked bright green and  tasted homemade.  I didn't taste the bruschetta, but my companion praised the sparing use of red onion in the tomato mix, making it perfectly balanced.

I had the scialatelli alla vongole, of course, with a side of the grilled vegetable salad with goat cheese.  I asked them to just bring both dishes as ready because I didn't want to eat them in sequence.  That's exactly how I got them, with the grilled veg first, and the pasta maybe 5 minutes later to eat along side.  My partner got his two starters in non overlapping sequence, exactly as requested as well.

The vongole was great.  There were maybe 8 clams in shells decorating the dish but plenty more shelled clams stirred through the pasta.  The clams were perfectly cooked and still tender and juicy.  I liked the restrained use of fresh cherry tomato sauteed in olive oil, which didn't dominate.  I could taste the good quality olive oil. The thick scialatelli was delightfully chewy.  It wasn't quite as spectacular as the version I ate on my last visit eight years ago, which included an unorthodox quantity of garlic.  Maybe next time I will ask if the current chef is willing to put in a little garlic for me.  The grilled vegetable salad with a thin slice of toasted goat cheese was excellent.  On top of the mixed green salad there were slices of grilled courgette, grilled eggplant and very sweet strips of peeled red pepper.  I was happy to note that the roasted pepper was homemade, having no hint of the acidic preservatives that peeled roast peppers from a jar has.

The cheapest bottles of wine are £29 and £30, and dinner including a bottle of red came to £78.  Music and noise levels are low.  There was an 80s pop soundtrack playing during our visit. We will definitely be back and won't wait eight years before our next visit.

This is my local .. my partner and I live across the road and we frequent often.. I love the style of Italian which focuses on their region I think. I have forgotten their names the wonderful waitress and lovely chef, she has told me so many times but due to my chemotherapy my memory is shot.. I love it there, it’s small and quaint and it feels familiar in a good way.. sometimes it can get very loud but hey.. it’s part of it.. We are so happy to have “Italina”here even if my partner is vegan.. they do like one or two vegan things but overall.. it’s a lovely experience…

Terrific place. I had a fried pizza for the first time ever and I wasnt disappointed. The carbonara and strawberry tiramisu were also amazing. Recommend if you are looking for an authentic italian place ! 🤌🏼

Great and tasty traditional Italian restaurant! Service was great and fast, kind staff, and very flavorful pizzas. Tiramisu as dessert is very recommended, creamy and traditional. Overall very recommended, plus the location seem very traditional, it felt as being in a small restaurant in Italy!

It's hard to find good pizza nowadays around London and Italina it's a place for a proper Italian pizza. The food was amazing and I truly mean it. I have enjoyed every single bite of food. Everything was just spot on. I really do recommend this tiny Italian restaurant.

places.formatted_address: 53 Old Bethnal Green Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 6QA, UK
places.name: The Common E2

reviews.text: What a lovely cafe! I’m so glad that I happened upon it by chance, while roaming around the area. The coffee was delicious, as was the cake that I chose. Many thanks to the lovely lady and gentleman who served me. I was made to feel very welcome and I do hope that I get the opportunity to visit again. Thank you also for the excellent music being played in the background 😊

Lovely place with gluten-free and celiac options. I got the chocolate brownies and carrot cake for a friend. Definitely coming back! Friendly staff and perfect for bringing your laptop and answering some emails. Top!

Lovely tiny cafe.
I had a smoked bacon wrap, which was really lovely, flavoursome with a hint of mustard.
My flat white was fantastic, made by the tall friendly barista. Lot of regular customers too.
I was under the impression, after listening to a Coffee podcast of Mark - the owner - and looking at the pictures that the place was bigger - only a table of 6, the back was a workshop area -  and had a more extensive menu. Which was quite limited on the day of my visit.
I still recommend a visit if you are in the area.

An absolute hidden gem for brunch. The atmosphere and decor is so lovely and relaxing. Whole space is very light and airy. The staff are really friendly and sweet. We felt very welcome. The food is delicious. Very fresh and good quality. Also a great price - we paid £13 a head for a breakfast and coffee. Will definitely be stopping by again soon.

Popped in as I was in the area and remembered the cafe from my time at Crown Works Pottery. Ordered a lemon chicken sandwich and a cappuccino to go. The sandwich was honestly one of the best I've had. Sandwiches can be quite expensive nowadays, but I'm honestly more disappointed than pleased.
This sarnie was delicious. Flavours were bold and complementary. The sourdough wasn't overpowering either. Oh and the bread didn't slice my gums into bits.

Def will stop by again, if im in the area!

places.formatted_address: 391 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9RA, UK
places.name: Perfetto Pizza ( Bethnal Green )

reviews.text: It’s was a phenomenal bite! Taste of their pizza 9/10 really good pizza chef here and their service is friendly as always highly recommended ⚡️👌

The name speaks for its self, the pizza there is made from fresh ingredients and it leaves you feeling satisfied unlike other greasy fast foods. The staff and service is exceptional, the price is amazing especially for students. Would definitely recommend.

Have ordered from them for 4/5 events now, catering up to 80 people at a time. Each and every time they have been on time, with great quality pizza and very affordable too. The best part is lots of people coming up to me and telling it the pizza was delicious after each event. Many thanks to your team!

Ordered for the first time. Definitely ordering again. Absolutely delicious pizza. The dough was just perfect and super fresh. Flavours were great. This was a home delivery so cannot comments on restaurant atmosphere etc.

I've had food from here twice in the last couple months or so. The food was okay, nothing to write home about but it's your usual London chicken shop / PFC style experience.

First time I had Doner kebab and chips, it wasn't the masala fried type, but it was the plain type of Doner kebab, chopped up and I assume fried again because it was really greasy/oily. Overcooked too because it was borderline on the hard side, but still tasted okay and managed to finish it satisfied.

I had a 7" beef pizza more recently, and it tasted good, but it's the usual type of pizza you'd expect from most pizza places in East London at least (similar to the likes of Mario's pizza, Pizza GoGo, Tops Pizza etc.). Again, this isn't a negative point, as these are all places many people enjoy eating from.

The store atmosphere was good and the staff were quiet but straightforward no-fuss and I appreciate that.

Food is Halal, and they allow you to order in advance by phone for collection, or you can probably order via a delivery app like just eat or Uber eats.

While the food may not be nothing amazing to write home about, it's always good to support your local smaller businesses so if you're feeling in a cheaty mood, give them a go 😊

places.formatted_address: 235 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 6AB, UK
places.name: Phat For Life

reviews.text:
I’ve been hearing about this place for a while now, but I never had the chance to try it until my first visit. The seating is downstairs and quite small, but it’s cosy. We were lucky to get a table quickly.

We ordered the Haji Platter, which was more than enough for us four girls. It came with three smash burgers, kebab, wings, chicken strips, fried prawns, chips with brisket, and coleslaw. There were also three drinks included.

The best part of the platter was the brisket and smash burgers! The burgers were so juicy and melted in your mouth. The brisket was full of flavour and soft. I usually don’t like lamb doner, but this one was nice and spicy. The chicken strips were fried with a light batter and covered in a creamy sauce.

The service was great and the staff was really attentive. We did have a bit of a problem with the lights flickering, but the staff quickly turned them off and gave us lamps instead.

Overall, we really enjoyed the food here and will definitely come back again.

Went there for my birthday. The place was busy as the food was good and reasonably priced. The platter we ordered was way too big for us, and we had to ask for a takeaway as we only finished 25% of the platter. Again, the platter (£90) was monstrous, enough to serve 8 people, imo. Taste was very good, alhamdulillah. Unfortunately, you can't book a table in advance due to the sitting capacity as the sitting space is in the basement and very cosy, limited to accommodate a small number of people. I think they would definitely benefit from having a larger place. The food is halal and tasty, and the owner is very humble. May Allah give baraka to the business.

10 / 10 on the smash burgers.
We had Hajj box and Fire Box both were amazing fresh food and great atmosphere.

Jazaka'Allah khair to brother Zakariyah

I’ve traveled a few times to eat their food, I must say the first couple times when they first opened the food was amazing. However my most recent experience was very disappointing, the chicken wings smelt, the chips were fried in a mixed/old oil, the kebab was very oily and the ‘naga’ flavour was non existent. After almost spending £100, I would’ve liked to be left satisfied with the food. My genuine words of advice would be to start focusing on quality once again and try to bring back the original flavour which the food once had.

My Friends and I visited Phat for life for the first time after hearing so much about it and thought we would give it a try. My expectations were high as it had been recommended by a number of my foodie friends.

I can honestly say the Food was 10/10, they really are the Naga Kings, I went for the Jaal Doner and it was top tier.

The Staff were friendly and recommended some dishes off the menu. If you are looking to eat in, I highly advise to call them to ask how long the queue is, we had to wait around an hour as it was very busy but definitely worth the wait.

To finish it off I grabbed one of their Karak chais  on my way out and that was by far one of the best karaks I've had, I cant wait to go back soon.

places.formatted_address: 254 Globe Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 0JD, UK
places.name: The Full Monty

reviews.text: A friend recommended this spot, and it’s quickly become my go-to brunch place in London. The food is fresh, the portions are generous, and the variety on the menu is impressive—all at great value. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, but what truly sets this place apart is the exceptional service. Staff like Nafisa and Florin greet you with the warmest smiles, no matter how busy it gets. Their genuine hospitality makes every visit feel special. I honestly couldn’t recommend this place more—give it a try and you’ll see exactly why.

I ordered the GG Royale (9.5) – 2 poached eggs on sourdough with smoked salmon & hollandaise (exactly as described on the menu). What I was served, however, was a plate covered in an overpowering vinegar-based decorative sauce and a side salad, neither of which were mentioned anywhere. The bread was drenched in the sauce and completely inedible.

When I raised this with staff, I was met with irritation rather than any attempt to resolve the issue. One member even said, “Next time ask for the sauce to be removed” -a sauce that isn’t even listed on the menu. Instead of being offered a replacement or solution, I was still charged for food I could not eat.
Incredibly disappointing experience, especially as I had skipped breakfast to come here. Poor customer service and misleading menu descriptions.

Visited on 30th March 2025 and was really disappointed. I was served a jacket potato that was clearly from a packet and had visible mould — absolutely unacceptable. Shocking that something like this made it to the table. Won’t be returning unless there’s a serious improvement in quality control and care. I ordered a takeaway as the café was super busy on the weekends.
Great food for a decent price. It has a large selection of meals and drinks. The portions are generous and of really good quality. Enjoyed our breakfast there.

Proper east London caf. Always full and buzzing of locals, builders and off duty police from the station over the road.
Food is delicious, portions generous and very reasonably priced. I’m here at least once a week!

places.formatted_address: 202 Three Colts Ln, Bethnal Green, London E2 6JN, UK
places.name: Arches Cafe

reviews.text: A proper British caff! Tucked away, as the name would suggest, in the Arches of the overground bridge just a short walk from Bethnal Green station. The food was excellent and easy to order as you’d hope. The service was warm and friendly, I believe it’s a family business, which is always great to see too. I enjoyed the old school 4 seater tables and the brickwork interior is a nice touch, but the thing that really makes the places charm is the quiet rumble of the trains passing overhead! I will definitely be back, and bringing friends.

Kind service in a place with great atmosphere under the railtracks. Food was really good, but not outstanding. Chips could be a bit crunchier, green peas could be more moised or steamed. But those are details, after all we were really satisfied with a great breakfast experience. 5*

Arches Cafe – A Hidden Gem Beneath the Tracks We stopped by Arches Cafe in Bethnal Green and were genuinely surprised — in the best way. Tucked under the railway arches, this family-run spot serves up classic British comfort food with heart and hospitality.

The full English breakfast was generous and well-balanced: crispy bacon, golden eggs, and mushrooms that actually tasted fresh. The tea came in a proper mug, and the toast was just right — no frills, no fuss, just good honest food.

The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who clearly care about the place. It’s the kind of café where locals linger and newcomers feel instantly at ease.

Arches Cafe may look modest, but it delivers warmth, flavour, and a slice of East London charm. A lovely surprise — and one we’d happily repeat.

The business is spotless and beautifully maintained, with a warm, cozy atmosphere that makes you feel welcome right away. The food was absolutely delicious—full of flavor and clearly made with care. On top of that, the service was outstanding: genuinely kind, attentive, and full of enthusiasm. Altogether, it was a wonderful experience that I’d be happy to return to again and again.

Always a very welcoming experience. Lovely staff and lovely food! The cafe is spotless and the toilets immaculate! I have been eating in this cafe years and they always pleased to see me! I recommend this place 1000% you won’t be disappointed ❤️

editorial_summary.overview: Afro-Portuguese chain for flame-grilled peri-peri chicken in African bird’s-eye chilli at different heat flavours.

places.formatted_address: 366 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E2 0AH, UK
places.name: Nando's Bethnal Green

reviews.text:
Halal Nandos on Bethnal Green Road. The place is really nice. Staff are efficient and friendly. I was served by Sumiya who was very attentive and courteous.

The place is clean and food arrived promptly.

The walls have some oil marks which takes away from it's cleanliness. It should be decorated with greaseproof paint which can easily be cleaned.

Otherwise happy to visit again.

My recent visit to Nando's was absolutely fantastic, and I have to give a huge shout-out to the incredible staff for making the experience so memorable especially Mark! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with genuine warmth and seated promptly, which was a welcome start to a busy afternoon.
The team was truly a standout. Our server was exceptionally attentive and friendly, checking in at the perfect times without being intrusive. They were quick to offer recommendations and answer all our questions about the different spice levels and menu options.The food arrived much faster than expected, which is always a bonus! It was clear that the staff worked together like a well-oiled machine, and everyone seemed to genuinely enjoy their jobs.
Of course, the food was delicious as always—the peri-peri chicken was perfectly cooked and bursting with flavour, and the side dishes were excellent. But it was the exceptional service that elevated our meal from just exceptional. We felt truly looked after and valued as customers.
Thank you to the staff at Nando's for a wonderful afternoon. We'll definitely be back soon!
The best Nando I been to so clean and staff so friendly and helpful I would give 10 stars as they wowed me so much
One of the best Nandos I been to , staff are  friendly and helpful.
ZEE is a very helpful and nice worker. Legend top 1 Nandos workers of all time. Assisted me to a seat very quickly after seeing me and my crutch.

places.formatted_address: 43 Burdett Rd, Bow, London E3 4TN, UK
places.name: Al-Safa Grill

reviews.text:
I usually visited and was blown away by the quality and service. The food was hot, fresh, and absolutely delicious — especially the cold fish fries, juicy burgers, or chicken wingz Everything tasted like it had just come off the grill!

The staff were friendly and efficient, getting orders out quickly even though the place was busy. I appreciated how clean and well-organized the restaurant was, including the dining area and restrooms.

Prices were very reasonable for the portion sizes,especially single cold fish  only 5£ comparing to Wingz Hut (6£ for it )

Overall, this was one of the best fast food experiences I’ve had in a long time. Highly recommend for a quick, satisfying meal!

The place is good..
They forgot my order.
Also, for card payments, you need to order a minimum of 5 £
I ordered a double cheese burger. The patty, however, was a bit burnt, and I could get the burnt patty taste
Chicken wrap was okay
Overall, it's good for a quick meal at this price

Chicken was hard like rock and pink. They refried it to sell the chicken. Disgusting. Don’t know why these greedy people do that. Just throw the old chicken away. Never going there again . My son couldn’t eat it. They lucky I ain’t got time time to go to their shop to argue over this. Waste of money. Will complain to relevant authorities as well. Why sell food that you won’t eat yourself?

One of my best fast food places, excellent food, good friendly service, always look forward to ordering from there.

However they are serving Israeli drinks, they will need to remove them soon.

Order special offer for doner kebab, thought it would come with bread but came with chips instead when asked to change they dumped a cold pitta bread underneath hot kebab like they were doing me a favour as most kebab shop would ask your preference, then tried to order 25 wings for £9 but was told there offer expired as the leaflet was old, thought the price you advertised should be the Price consumers pay but that isn’t the case. The worst kebab experience I ever hard, wouldn't recommend to anyone made a mistake should have gone to spice hut, as they also struggled to give takeaway box  for left over food by kids.

The response I got the owner was a laugh as I never been there before and I pick up the menu from his counter today so why has he got 3 years old leaflet still in the premises plus the cashier should should ask for your preference before taking your order sorry I didn’t know that customer Ned’s to ask instead hahah very disappointed with the cover up stoey

places.formatted_address: 169 Mile End Rd, Stepney Green, London E1 4AQ, UK
places.name: Sweet Café - Stepney

reviews.text: This place is absolutely amazing! The desserts, crepes, and ice cream are incredibly delicious, and the presentation of every dish is so beautiful. The staff is kind, friendly, and truly makes you feel welcome. And honestly – these are the best crepes of my life!!! Thank you so much!!! Highly recommend!

I remember visiting this place when it first opened, and it’s now under new management — and quite different from what it used to be. That said, it’s definitely up and running again and doing well.

The food and desserts were very good — just as you’d expect, though I do remember them being slightly better during the original launch when there was a lot more buzz around the place.

The environment was clean and welcoming, but the true highlight of the visit was the service. I believe we were served by the owner himself, and his attention to detail and commitment to customer satisfaction really stood out. He made sure we didn’t miss anything and was always one step ahead.

The only reason I’m giving four stars instead of five is purely based on the comparison to when it first opened — the initial excitement and a slight edge in food quality back then made it just a bit more special.

Still, a great spot worth visiting, especially for the service!

We popped in for some crepes on pancake day. We ordered two mocktails (apple & cherry and the strawberry one) and two crepes, one with banantella and rocher (so this is sliced banana, nutella, ice cream and rocher chocolate on top!) , and a bueno one (this came with chocolate, white chocolate, ice cream, cream and 2 buenos on top!).
The place is very nice, looks recently renovated, with comfortable, nice looking furniture, a green wall feature and a big indoor tree, along with some other interesting interior details. The service is very attentive and friendly. They have an extensive offering of crepes, waffles, american pancakes, french toast, baked to order cookie dough, a wide selection of cakes, sandwiches and pastries. Nice place to sit for a quick coffee, a casual dessert after dinner nearby or a group gathering. They have several 4 and 6 seater tables, booths, a large 10 people table and another 12 ish coherent table. Everything is traditional milk, butter, sugar made so we left on a very high sugar high. It's not going to be our go-to place as they dont have gluten free, vegan or low sugar offerings yet, but we will probably be back to try the french toast and the Kashmiri pin chai one Saturday. I was told they open 8 am every day so I think opening hours are incorrect on google.

On the whole I think this is a good coffee and dessert shop.  It’s clean, bright and has a lovely rear section to it.
The service was excellent and friendly and attentive.

The coffee was good, but not exceptional. I had a latte which was slightly bitter.

The two disappointments for me were the food and the noise.

I had a chocolate brownie which was wonderfully presented but it tasted like they had sprayed the base of the pan with a light oil before heating the brownie - as a result there was an oily taste to the brownie which was disappointing.

The second issue was this is not a place for solo or small groups - at least when I was here at 4pm. There were multiple groups with young children ranging from 2-6yrs old who were very boisterous and loud. While I realize that this could be viewed as an unfair observation it’s just my factual observation.
If you have a young kids and you want to meet as groups I think this is a fantastic place to come.

But for my friend and I who came to have a catch up we would not come back here again.

What an experience we had today at Sweets Cafe! While our visit started with a bit of an unexpected hiccup, it quickly turned into a testament to outstanding customer service and delicious treats.
As we walked in, my child unfortunately vomited onto the floor. I can't express enough gratitude for how wonderfully the staff handled the situation. They immediately came to help and clearing up the mess efficiently and with such genuine kindness, allowing me to fully attend to my child. They directed me to the bathroom, which was clean and well-stocked, making it easy to get my little one cleaned up.
After everything was settled, one of the kind workers even offered my child a croissant, which was incredibly thoughtful, especially since I wasn't letting him eat anything else until his stomach had settled. It was such a compassionate gesture that really helped calm a stressful moment.

Once we finally got to enjoy the desserts, they did not disappoint! We ordered Karak chai, baklava cheesecake and cookies doughs which were all very delicious!

Overall, despite the initial chaos, our experience at Sweets Cafe was truly positive.  We'll definitely be back, and we highly recommend it to anyone looking for a sweet treat and fantastic service!

places.formatted_address: London E3 4UR 22, Bow Business Centre, Bow, triangle E3 4UR, UK
places.name: La Bella napoli

reviews.text:
I visited La Bella Napoli with my friends in London during my birthday trip, and it was truly an unforgettable experience! Even though it was late at night, Chef Bari and his amazing team welcomed us so warmly and went above and beyond to make us feel at home. Every single dish was made fresh, full of flavor, and absolutely delicious.

What stood out the most was their incredible hospitality—they didn’t just serve us food, they created a fun, memorable night that made us feel like family. It was the perfect way to celebrate, and I’m so grateful for the kindness and energy they shared with us.

From now on, this will be a must-have stop each time I come to London. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, genuine warmth, and a truly special dining experience!

Definitely have new owners or chef because they disappointed me today bad quality not cooked properly no flavours very very bad. They lost a regular customer. Quality dropped. Used chicken strips for pizza no sauce no flavours no base dead my child could make better also known as KING PIZZA on Uber eats
Absolutely loved the food and the service was even better!!! They made us feel welcome and really accommodated us 🫶

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I tried their fried chicken and it was excellent — crispy, juicy, and full of flavor. The service was great and really friendly, which made the experience even better. Definitely worth a visit!
Amazing pizza and customer service!! Great late night spot for sure.

places.formatted_address: unit 46a, London E17 7JR, UK
places.name: Shah's Halal Food Walthamstow

reviews.text:
Amazing food, amazing staff, very friendly and polite, clean and the green sauce is good. Musa welcomed us very nicely.

Especially when habibi came from upstairs we just had a laugh and enjoyed our time. Well recommend.

Shah’s is a good place for chicken and rice, with sauce and salad. They are generous with meat and rice - wish I could have gotten a bit more salad. Also think they gave me a bit too much white sauce - I like the spicy sauce better.

An improvement would be the trays. A study found that 85% of black plastic was shown to have high levels of flame retardants, including food trays.

Absolutely outstanding experience at Shah’s Halal Food! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a spotless, clean atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The food? Incredible. Every bite is bursting with authentic, perfectly seasoned flavors. Their platters are generous, the rice is always fluffy, and the meats are cooked to perfection  tender, juicy, and full of bold, savory spices.

A huge shoutout to Hapip and the entire staff for their warm, friendly service. Hapip went above and beyond to make sure everything was just right and added a personal touch to our visit. It’s rare to find a place where both the food and the people leave such a lasting impression.

If you’re craving delicious halal eats in a clean, welcoming setting, Shah’s Halal is the spot. Highly recommend   can’t wait to come back!

First time trying the Walthamstow branch and they did not disappoint! Portions were huge and taste was great too. Right next to the mall entrance too so quite convenient. Will definitely be back. We got the chicken over rice with white and green sauce as it’s the best item on the menu I’m not a fan of their lamb but chicken is chefs kiss. Servers don’t come across as friendly bubbly maybe that’s their personality but other than that tasty food for good prices.

Came here for lunch to try out the chicken & rice platter.
It was flavoursome, well cooked & tasted great.
However the salad did not look fresh & they could have been more generous with the sauce.
Will still recommend a try if you are nearby.

places.formatted_address: 14 Barking Rd, London E6 3BP, UK
places.name: De Cafe Lounge & De biryani Lounge

reviews.text:
I went to this place for a quick lunch recently,  they have a great menu, the place is clean and the staff are friendly and provide excellent service. They also do a great halal breakfast and cater for vegetarians.

They have one of the best cereal collections available for your breakfast.

I had a mixed Lamb and Chicken diner with saucy chips and to drink a Bubblegum Mojito. Which both tasted great, I would be definitely be coming back here to eat again. This place is HMC certified.

I am always on the hunt for a high quality halal breakfast place. Just so fed up of over priced, sub standard menus that just don't hit the spot. Until I found De Cafe Lounge on Barking Road. It is near the old West Ham Football Ground and walking distance from Upton Park Station. Plenty of parking nearby, free and paid.

You are welcomed by friendly staff, a nice clean premises, large tv screen and lots of breakfast options. You can get lamb donner in your breakfast plate, yes you read it correctly, LAMB DONNER. It is sooo tasty, you will love this place.

The tea seemed to have a sprinkle of safron on it, it tasted so nice, I orders another one. I never have two couples of tea back to back. The owner Imran is a lovely chap, knows his food and understands customer service.

While I am writting this post, I have decided I am going to go there for breakfast NOW!

Salim Patel
Food wasn't too bad apart from the chips were cold. In all honesty prices are too expensive and staff are a tad grumpy.  £10 for a full English way too much to be honest.
Went here recently, place has gone completely downhill. The menu has completely changed under new management, worse thing was the burger bun had mould on it.  disgusting!

Well the missus and i went there to have breakfast. The Sausages weren't so great and the missus complained there was too much oil on her food. The portions were tiny compared to other places we've been to.

The atmosphere is also pretty dull, it has plenty of seating which looked almost like a big school dinner hall. Portions were also tiny as you can see from the images below.

I think it deserves a fair 3 stars for my experience.

places.formatted_address: 57 Hoe St, London E17 4SA, UK
places.name: PAR LONDON - PAK AL REYAN RESTAURANT

reviews.text: Very nice fries and club sandwich. Not too sure about the egg inside, would be better with real cheese instead of the plastic slices. Stayed crispy and didn't go soggy. Liked the packaging.

We tried Desi Nashta, club sandwich and cheese paratha. Taste was amazing and delicious. Good Environment and Excellent Hygiene.
strongly Recommend Every one to give it a try.

We had a lovely desi breakfast served by the sweetest staff Aksha & Ravneet.
We will definitely be returning again very soon! :)
Thank you!!

Mouth watering food , amazing taste .
Very good service . Friendly staff

Nice little takeaway.
food was spot on.
prices were reasonable compared to overall London takeaways.
recommended

places.formatted_address: 345 Barking Rd, London E6 1LA, UK
places.name: Lala’s Grill & Restaurant

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing food! Lalas serves some of the best Pakistani dishes I’ve had — full of rich, authentic flavours and perfectly cooked. Every bite was bursting with spice and aroma. The service was friendly and welcoming too, which made the whole experience even better. And omg, the mango lassi was incredible — creamy, refreshing, and just the right amount of sweetness. Highly recommend this place if you’re craving truly excellent Pakistani food!

I came here for my birthday meal, and the whole experience was absolutely amazing! 🎉 The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and everything from start to finish was perfect. The food is absolutely delicious – every dish was packed with flavour and beautifully presented. The peri peri sauce is SO nice, and they’re so generous with the amount they give you – it’s the perfect touch! It’s so good that I find myself coming back again and again.

A special mention to Sarah – she is such a lovely person with fantastic customer service, making you feel genuinely cared for throughout your visit. And the mojitos… wow! They are honestly to die for – so refreshing and perfectly balanced.

If you’re looking for great food, amazing drinks, and friendly service, this place is a must-visit. Can’t wait for my next visit!

We were in the area and I popped in with the family! I can’t not express how wonderful the staff are here especially Sara who offered to take care of the baby while we ate. And staff helped wash the baby bottle. Food was really nice my parents loved it- lamb chops were delicious. Drinks were not too sweet and tasty. I would highly recommend the tawa- the family of 4 one could feed 5-6 and the lamb meat was so soft. Parents loved the rice pudding. Definitely will come back here again with family. One of the most kindest staff I’ve met. Thank you for being so welcoming and kind.

Very good food
Must try , such a good quantity and quality.
And service was really friendly.
Do visit guys you won't regret.

The food was okay I felt like they could put more flavour on the chicken And the other meat. Environment was nice.
Cocktail drink was good.
Customer service was up-to-date the girl who served us was really nice and friendly.
I think I ordered too much me and my friend couldn’t even finish it, but we took it home.

I spent around £50

editorial_summary.overview: Contemporary venue offering halal steaks, mocktails, flame shows & a shisha lounge.

places.formatted_address: 20 Woodford New Rd, London E17 3PR, UK
places.name: MyShish

reviews.text: I recently visited My Shish Woodford and had an amazing experience! The food was incredible — especially the Smash Tacos, Wagyu Burger, and Mix Grill Sizzler. The mocktails were refreshing, and the shisha was smooth and relaxing. The atmosphere was elegant yet cosy, with great service throughout. Definitely one of the best Mediterranean lounges in the area — can’t wait to visit again!

I genuinely don’t even know where to start — this place was an absolute disaster from beginning to end. The customer service was beyond shocking, easily the worst I’ve ever experienced. It honestly felt like we were part of some hidden camera prank.

We came here to celebrate my dad’s 60th birthday, and it turned into a complete nightmare. The restaurant wasn’t even busy, yet we waited over 45 minutes — not even for food, just for drinks! When they finally came, my piña colada arrived with no ice whatsoever — I didn’t even know that was possible.

The food was just as bad — bland and tasteless. The so-called “mac and cheese” tasted like someone threw pasta in a bowl and sprinkled cheese on top. No seasoning, no flavour, nothing. Orders were mixed up or forgotten altogether, and every time we tried to get the staff’s attention, they looked lost or ignored us completely.

By the time we tried to pay, we’d had enough. The confusion continued — they tried to charge us for the food we had cancelled, so we asked for another correct bill, which took so long. We ended up getting up and going to the front just to pay because we knew we’d be sitting there all night otherwise.

The entire experience was a shambles and completely ruined what was meant to be a special night for my dad’s 60th. To top it off, they don’t even serve complimentary bread or sauce like every other Turkish restaurant I’ve been to. Honestly, this place needs serious management changes — the food, the service, the organisation — all of it was terrible. Never again.

It was really quiet but we did come on a Tuesday evening and it was a tube strike day. We ordered a few starters and the tomahawk steak, some extra fries and a pasta dish for my son.
The prawns and calamari were great and served pretty quickly, the calamari serving was considerably smaller than I'd expect with only 3 on the plate.
The tomahawk was cooked to perfection, good flavor and just how we requested, medium rare, my son also loved his pasta. The fries were also super crispy 👌
The service was fantastic, super attentive and amazing value for money.  We had the restaurant to ourselves on this occasion but I can imagine on the weekend it having great vibes, the music was afrobeats but not overbearing loud. This is a hidden gem in North Ldn and we'll be sure to be back

I recently dined at MyShish in London and had a fantastic experience. The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. The restaurant was nicely laid out with elegant decor and top tier ambient lighting that made the space feel modern yet intimate.

Free parking was a big bonus, especially in London, and the fact that all food is halal gave us peace of mind.

For starters, I had the hummus with warm bread. The hummus was smooth and tasty, but the soft and fresh bread really stood out. I also tried the pulled beef bao bun. The bun was soft and slightly sweet, and the beef was slow cooked to perfection. It was tender, juicy, and had a subtle kick of spice. A very satisfying start to the meal.

For mains, I went with the prime rib eye steak cooked medium rare, served with peppercorn sauce and chips. The steak was beautiful, juicy, tender, and perfectly pink inside. The peppercorn sauce was creamy with just the right amount of heat. The chips were crisp on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and well seasoned. I also ordered a side of mac and cheese which was creamy, cheesy, and cooked just right. Every part of the meal was excellent.

To drink, I had the Unicorns Ride mocktail. The lychee flavour really came through and hit the spot. It was delicious, though at nine pounds it felt slightly expensive for the size. I just wish the glass had been a bit bigger.

Service was a real highlight. I want to mention the waitress who served us. She was a tall South Asian lady with her hair tied back and what I believe was a tattoo on her wrist. She was respectful, professional, and calm even while dealing with a very difficult family of four seated next to us. The parents were shockingly rude, asking awkward questions about how food was cooked, finishing most of their meal, and then complaining to try and get a discount. It was uncomfortable to watch, and I wanted to say something, but my family convinced me not to. Despite their behaviour, the waitress handled them with grace and professionalism. People in hospitality should never be treated like that. I hope she knows she did a fantastic job and made our evening much better.

Another great touch is the shisha bar located at the back of the restaurant. It is a relaxing space designed with the same attention to atmosphere and detail as the main dining area. A perfect way to wind down after a great meal.

As someone who works in the NHS, I also made use of the ten percent discount, which I already knew about before visiting. It was a thoughtful gesture and very much appreciated.

All in all, MyShish delivered a high quality experience from start to finish. Friendly staff, a beautifully designed setting, flavourful halal food, and truly impressive service. With the added perks of free parking, a lovely shisha lounge, and NHS discount, it is a complete evening experience. I will definitely be returning and highly recommend it to others looking for a memorable meal out.

I think the restaurant in Woodford is under new management, I went there and service was terrible and so was the quality of the food.

Usually when you go to a restaurant you get served your drinks first we had to wait about 20mins for that and that only because I asked the staff can we have our drinks at least.

When serving another table behind us, the two waitresses dropped and broke the sauce pots which shattered all around us.

Upon getting our food our “mac and cheese” was not even Mac and cheese it was just pasta with cheese sprinkled on.

The waitress and waiters were all lost, they was running all over the place and when trying to call them, they ignored you.

They sung happy birthday to someone but that required the entire kitchen staff to come out and stop operation of the restaurant.

When we wanted to pay our bill, apparently only the manager can take payment. Which when I asked he went with the card machine to another table to take their payment. Due to this we got up and went to the front to pay as if not they would’ve delayed me further. When walking up to the desk the waitress said wait at the table you can pay there where I said it’ll take too long. She went and got thr manager and he took payment but when I said I don’t wanna pay the service charge he got a bit mad and asked sarcasticly “would you like your recipt sir”

In my opinion this restaurant is under new management who are should not be in the “Mediterranean cuisine” sector and should think about changing their strategies.

places.formatted_address: 84-86 High Rd, London E18 2NA, UK
places.name: Salash Kitchen - South Woodford

reviews.text: Absolutely love Salash Kitchen . The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the food is consistently top-notch. I had the İskender and it was phenomenal — tender meat, perfectly seasoned, and the yogurt and sauce combination was spot on. Easily one of the best Turkish meals I’ve had in London. Highly recommend!

Amazing atmosphere and more importantly the food was delicious, the service was welcoming and very quick. Definitely recommend this restaurant for its cleanliness, food quality and friendly staff. Special shout out to Toni who made us feel welcomed and valued.

THE BEST TURKISH ! 👌🏾 walked past then decided to pop in to this stylish spot.  The staff were welcoming, friendly and genuinely looked like they enjoyed working there.  The tables and seating were spotless and so were the menus.
We ordered from the perfectly priced lunch 2 course menu and was not disappointed.  The food is well presented and seasoned to perfection.  Washed down with a cheeky martini and this sealed the deal for me sharing with all my friends on  every platform.  Thank you Yaz (our waitress) and the amazing team in the kitchen. See you again soon! 😋 🍽 🥰

Salish in South Woodford is an absolute gem. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a warm, welcoming atmosphere and stylish decor that sets the tone for a great evening.

The food is full of flavour, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care and quality ingredients. Every bite feels thoughtfully crafted, and the menu offers a great variety to suit different tastes.

Service is outstanding — friendly, attentive, and professional. The staff go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and valued as a guest.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a quality dining experience in East London. Will definitely be returning!

The restaurant is nice and spacious with beautiful decor. The Toilets/washroom are clean. Service was good and the food arrived quickly.

I ordered the Mixed Shish marinated lamb and chicken on skewers - the meat was super tender and full of flavour, it came with rice and salad. The salad was a good size portion and tasted fresh. Chips were good.

The bread was soft and the sauces were delicious.

The passion fruit mojito was meant to be a sweet drink, but it was quite sour.
